items.title: free pet insurance? The "prop pet" scam involved in a million-dollar case and more than 400 insurance defrauds was exposed
items.core: Friends who have pets at home must be careful! You think you can get pet medical insurance for free at a pet hospital, but in fact your pet may have been used as a "money-making tool" by insurance fraud gangs!
body: Note: Friends who have pets at home must be careful! You think you can get pet medical insurance for free at a pet hospital, but in fact your pet may have been used as a "money-making tool" by insurance fraud gangs! Recently, the police uncovered a pet medical insurance fraud case involving more than 1 million yuan and more than 400 insurance policies. How on earth did they hide the truth and cheat like crazy? 👇 Looking for tool people: The gang borrows the ID cards of employees and retirees to buy pet insurance in bulk, and collects stray cats and dogs or buys cheap pets as "claim settlement props." Prepare claims in seconds: Police investigation found that a large number of pet insurance photos and accident claim photos were taken at the same time! A full set of claim materials was prepared on the day of purchase, and the initial cost was directly covered by a claim of up to 3,000 yuan. Minor ailments are exaggerated, and innocent illnesses cause diseases: After treatment and settlement of claims for extremely mild otitis and gastrointestinal problems, the amount is basically close to the maximum amount of 3,000 yuan. Modification of medical records late at night: The director of the pet hospital has the authority to modify the records. He can open the case system late at night, modify the pet's name, treatment time and items, and then reprint it for use. Driven by performance sharing: Hospitals and doctors have agreed on a 3% to 10% or even higher share of illegal drug fees, and the commission directly stimulates doctors to assist in fraud. Pretending to provide benefits: Under the guise of "free pet medical insurance", pet owners are induced to sign a bunch of documents (including an entrusted payment agreement, and the claim payment is directly deposited into the hospital account). Sample manipulation: During sampling, the assistant retained the test samples of sick cats and dogs and applied them to healthy pets to forge serious medical records. The pet owner was kept in the dark, and his beloved pet was nominally "severely ill", but in fact it was turned into a criminal tool! The legal network has been restored without leakage, and the 11 criminal suspects involved in the case have been subject to criminal compulsory measures in accordance with the law. If you encounter such illegal operations, please keep the evidence in time and report it to the relevant departments!

body: Note: Recently, a new fraud scheme targeting Xianyu sellers has quietly been launched! The tricks of the scammers are staggering - they can openly change your shipping address during express delivery! 😨 A Xianyu seller sells a mobile phone on the platform and agrees with the buyer to go through the "Inspection Treasure" process. Unexpectedly, on the way to send the mobile phone to the goods inspection store, the express delivery address was actually tampered with by a scammer! The current situation is: Inspection Bao has been unable to receive the package for a long time, but the scammer has boldly applied for a refund on Xianyu. Scammer (the mastermind): controls the core of the entire scam. This is the scariest part of the whole scam! When the seller uploads the express delivery order number on Xianyu, the scammer uses the express delivery order number and the seller's mobile phone number to modify the destination of the express delivery! The mobile phone that was supposed to be sent to the inspection bank was robbed midway. Is this a loophole in the express delivery system, or has the scammer obtained the seller's account information through illegal means (such as social engineering database)? When the seller found something was wrong and refused to refund, the scammers intensified their efforts and further invaded the seller's other accounts (such as JD.com and SF Express), stole points to redeem goods, and even performed various malicious operations on the APP to exert pressure and force the seller to proactively refund the goods to eliminate the problem. Scammers scan high-value goods in batches on second-hand platforms. ➡️ Obtain seller-related information through illegal channels. ➡️ Hire a proxy to take photos of the goods and agree to go to Inspection.com. This type of fraud scheme often casts a wide net. We would like to remind all second-hand platform sellers to be vigilant when selling high-value goods! body: Description: "Earn 3,000 yuan per order, get it done in one minute, and easily earn 300,000 yuan a month!" Doesn't it sound particularly exciting? Don’t rush into thinking you’ve found a shortcut to getting rich. This kind of “black and white” project that claims to be zero-cost and high-return is actually a carefully designed fraud trap! The most insidious part of this method is that it targets people in gray areas - it guarantees that you will not dare to call the police or speak out. But the more this happens, the more you need to take it apart and see clearly: you think you are "taking advantage of others", but in fact you are just the next victim. Fraudsters do not directly attack gambling websites, but target middlemen who handle private settlements for illegal gambling. These intermediaries themselves are in a gray area, lacking a formal automatic reconciliation system, and rely entirely on manual inspection. Fraudsters pretend to be ordinary exchange users to get in touch with them, and control each transaction to a small amount of less than 3,000 yuan to reduce the other party's defensiveness. Small amount is the key to the whole method: if the amount is small, the other party will be too lazy to be serious; if the amount is small, the other party will feel that "even if they are cheated, they will not lose much." It is precisely this mentality that allows middlemen to relax their scrutiny step by step. The core operation only requires one "P picture"! The fraudsters do not transfer a penny in the entire process, and use mapping software to forge screenshots that are exactly the same as the real transfer (modifying the transaction amount, serial number, and wallet address). After sending the screenshot, they frantically urged the middleman to transfer the digital assets first on the grounds of "network delay and urgent need for processing". The purpose of urging is to prevent you from having time to verify. When people are being urged and want to pay the "handling fee", they are most likely to skip the reconciliation step that should be done. The more similar the screenshots are, the easier it is for you to believe that "the money is already there, but it just hasn't arrived yet." The middleman was urged madly because of the small amount, and he directly transferred the digital assets of equal value without bothering to verify carefully. After the fraudsters obtained the assets, they immediately cashed them into cash through private channels, achieving huge profits of "three thousand per order, completed in one minute." Then quickly abandoned the account, changed to a new account and IP, and looked for the next victim. By the time the middleman discovered that "the picture was fake and the coins were gone," the other party had already disappeared. Want to chase? What you are doing is gray settlement, and calling the police is equivalent to exposing yourself; if you don’t call the police, you will never get your money back. This is exactly what scammers do when they start in gray areas. Scammers love to use "you're not clean anyway" to embolden themselves and to block your mouth. But legally, this is not true at all: what you are doing is gray settlement, and what he is doing is fraud - the two things are evaluated separately, and his fraud will not become legal just because "you are not innocent either." What is more realistic is that the gray gambling settlement you participate in may itself be suspected of providing a payment channel for gambling and money laundering. You thought you were "earning handling fees", but you may have been helping to launder criminal funds; and the person who deceived you took another cut on your head. There are pits at both ends. On the surface it looks like "black people eating black people", but in essence it is a naked fraud crime! Regardless of the victim's identity, as long as he fabricates facts, forges transfer vouchers, and illegally possesses other people's property, he is already suspected of fraud. According to the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law, anyone who defrauds public or private property reaching a corresponding amount will be held criminally responsible in accordance with the law. All side projects that claim to be "zero-cost monthly income of hundreds of thousands" end in legal trials. Any "zero-cost monthly income of hundreds of thousands" is considered a scam. A gentleman loves money and gets it in a wise way - stay away from all illegal gambling and gray industries, and never give scammers an entry point. If you have participated in gray settlement and were defrauded of assets by P-pictures, keep the chat history and the forged screenshot (the screenshot itself is evidence), and call the police as soon as possible; don't swallow it because "you are not clean", the crime of the scammer will not disappear because of your ashes. A gentleman loves money and gets it wisely. Stay away from all illegal gambling and gray industries, take the right path, and don’t touch the sidelines! Remember one sentence: What do you think you are doing in "Black and White"...

items.title: The "camouflage technique" of AI face-changing fraud: a photo + a few seconds of audio, how can the scammer transform instantly?
items.core: In the past, swindlers relied on "making up stories" to trick people, but now swindlers rely on "copies" to confuse people. With the popularization of AI technology, deepfakes and speech synthesis are used by criminals for fraud.
body: Explanation: In the past, swindlers relied on "making up stories" to trick people, but now swindlers rely on "cloning people" to confuse people. With the popularization of AI technology, deepfakes and speech synthesis technologies are used by criminals for fraud. If one day you receive an emergency video call from your "leader", the familiar face in the picture, the extremely realistic voice and tone are urging you to transfer an emergency fund to the designated account immediately; or if your son who is "study abroad" sends a video, urgently saying that he has encountered an accident and needs a deposit - will you put down all your precautions in an instant? Today I will show you this "camouflage technique". Criminals usually use the following methods to complete the attack: extract public videos and voice clips (even just 3 to 5 seconds) posted by the target person on social platforms, and use AI speech synthesis software to generate audio with consistent timbre. Scammers often send voice requests for transfers on the pretext of "I'm in a meeting and it's not convenient to make a phone call" or "I'm experiencing an emergency." The point is: there is no need for a complete recording of your speech. Just a few seconds of public laughter, a blessing, and a live original sound are enough for the model to reproduce the "like" tone. Every sound you post online is training material. High-definition portrait photos are taken, and the face of the victim's acquaintance is replaced with the face of the fraudster through an algorithm. In dynamic video calls, victims are induced to relax their vigilance by using disguises such as network delay and blurry images. The most fearful thing about face-changing is "movement": once you are asked to cover your face or turn your head quickly, the algorithm's processing of boundaries will be exposed. Scammers know this very well, so they will take the initiative to cover it up with "bad network" and "image lag" - which in itself is a flaw. According to relevant cases, the amount involved in this type of fraud is extremely high. Many victims hurriedly transferred money without multiple confirmations because they saw "familiar faces". The amount of losses ranged from tens of thousands to millions of yuan. Scammers will fill their words with words such as "Don't say anything", "The account will arrive soon", "The boss is waiting", and use a sense of urgency to save you the verification step. In essence, AI just makes "pretending to be an acquaintance" more real, and the core of the fraud has not changed: using trust + creating emergency + blocking secondary confirmation. Technology has been upgraded, but the defense method is still the same - slow down and go nuclear. Real-time face-swapping is still immature for edge processing of occluded objects and fast movements: waving hands horizontally in front of the face, turning the head, pinching faces, and forging faces often cause image jitter, edge distortion, or blurred focus. These flaws are the "evidence" that can be grasped by the naked eye. What's more important is that video calls can be recorded and broadcast, faces can be changed, and synthesized, but it is difficult for scammers to fake the fact that you dial the number that the other party originally saved. Putting the confirmation action back into the original channel bypasses all the hassle of AI. Using deep forgery and speech synthesis to impersonate others to commit fraud is an act of fraud; illegally collecting and using biometric information such as other people's faces and voiceprints may also violate legal red lines related to personal information protection. Technology is not a talisman. If you use it to deceive people, your crime will be increased. According to the relevant provisions of the "Criminal Law", those who defraud public or private property reaching a corresponding amount will be held criminally responsible in accordance with the law; those who organize and provide forgery tools and materials may also be held accountable accordingly. Principle of multi-channel verification: For any requests involving transfers, borrowings, personal ID cards or bank card information, do not rely solely on video calls or voice messages. Be sure to verify through the original contact number, face-to-face confirmation or third-party acquaintance. Observe technical loopholes: During a video call, you can ask the other party to wave horizontally in front of their face, turn their head, or pinch their face. Since the current real-time face-changing technology's processing of occlusions is prone to image jitter, edge distortion, or focus blur, such actions can make the fake face "reveal its true colors." Reduce exposure: on social platforms without privacy protection, post less high-definition...
Chapter: 📌 [Shadow Exposure] The core of AI fraud: low threshold + high realism 🔍 Why "seeing a face" is not the same as a real person

Routine: 1️⃣ Voice cloning: "Transform" in a few seconds of audio 🎙️ 2️⃣ Real-time face changing: replace a familiar face with a photo 🖼️ 3️⃣ Lifelike packaging: Use "urgency" to override your judgment ⏱️

Warning: ⚠️ Key points for identification: "Like" a voice does not mean "presence". If the voice prompts you to transfer money, borrow money, or give a verification code, treat it as "to be verified", and don't relax just because the voice sounds familiar. ⚠️Identification points: In the video, "the picture is just blurry", "just delayed" and "only half of the face is shown" is not due to bad luck, but because the other party is covering up his or her ugliness. The more this happens, the more necessary it is to confirm in person or over the phone.

Defense method: 🛡️ Prevention guide: master three tricks, and you will have peace of mind

Case: Aunt Wang received a video call from ‘Sun Tzu’, the picture and sound were lifelike, saying that someone was injured in a fight and urgently needed privacy. She transferred 80,000 yuan according to her 'grandson''s request without verification. Later she discovered that her grandson was studying at school and the so-called videos were all synthesized by AI.
items.remember:
Any request for transfer, loan, or verification code must not only be based on video/voice, but must be confirmed by the original phone number or in person.
In the video, ask the other person to wave, turn their head, pinch their face, and observe edge distortion and jitter; send less high-definition frontal photos and original sounds to platforms without privacy protection

items.title: One order can go up to 8,000 yuan! The "cross-platform signing" trap of Xianyu's low-priced mobile phones, you take a photo of the phone but only receive a few yuan of gadgets?
items.core: You happily took a picture of a brand-new Apple mobile phone with a price tag of seven to eight thousand yuan. The express delivery showed "signed for receipt"—but when you opened it, it turned out to be a gadget worth five or six yuan. This is not a science fiction movie, this is the "Pinduoduo signature" low-price scam that has been very rampant on Xianyu recently.
body: Explanation: A brand new Apple mobile phone with a price tag of 7,000 to 8,000 yuan is listed on the page with a price tag of 3,800 yuan. If you take a closer look, the comment section will all read "Alighted safely." You took the photo with joy, and three days later the express delivery showed "signed for receipt" - you opened the package and found a gadget worth five or six yuan. 😱 This is not a science fiction movie, this is the "Pinduoduo signature" low-price scam that has been very rampant on Xianyu recently. It is different from the previous "payment is not shipped": the scammer did ship the goods and the logistics did sign for it, but the package does not belong to you from beginning to end. The whole routine takes advantage of the information gap in the pickup code system of the post station. Black product gangs list brand-new mobile phones, tablets, computers and other high-value electronic products on Xianyu at "attractive prices" that are far lower than the market price. There is only one purpose: to attract you to place an order and get your delivery address and phone number. Note that they don't make money from this deal at all - your address and phone number are what they really want. After you place the order, here comes the key point: they won’t ship the goods to you on Xianyu. Instead, they will go to Pinduoduo and use the address and phone number you provided to take pictures of a gadget that costs a few yuan. Then, they will obtain the real express delivery number of the Pinduoduo order and fill it back into the Xianyu platform. In this way, both you and the Xianyu platform think that the seller has shipped the goods, and you can only wait for the express delivery with peace of mind. When the express arrives at the station, a pickup code will be generated. Because the Pinduoduo order was placed by a scammer, only he can receive the pickup code! The moment the pickup code was generated, he immediately arranged for an errand boy in the same city to pick up the express delivery based on the pickup code. The post shows "signed for", but you don't get anything, and you can't apply for a refund on Xianyu (because the logistics shows signed). Judging from the publicly disclosed cases, the single loss of this type of "signing on behalf of" scam can be thousands of yuan. Victims often give up the appeal first because "the logistics shows receipt", which in turn makes the scammers more unscrupulous. Being more serious is what they fear most. For the purpose of illegal possession, defrauding others of property by means of false shipments and fictitious transactions, if the amount is relatively large, constitutes a crime of fraud and will be investigated for criminal liability in accordance with the law; loopholes in the rules of organized and professional operating platforms are also not grounds for exemption. Using your address and phone number to place orders for others is also suspected of infringing on citizens' personal information. As long as buyers are ignorant and deceived, they will succeed. Anyone who is serious about his victims can always catch these scammers who are full of loopholes! If your Xianyu order shows that it has been signed for, but you don’t get the goods, don’t consider yourself unlucky yet. Follow these three steps: Courier stations are equipped with surveillance cameras, which can clearly prove that the errand boy took it, not you. The evidence is solid! Xianyu’s purchase order and the Pinduoduo package sent by the scammer are not the same thing at all. Electronic products require video recording by default. You can also check the true source of the package through the order number. Once you check, you will know that the package comes from a Pinduoduo seller. Pull away these evidences, don’t hesitate, call the police directly and complain to the platform! Don’t consider yourself unlucky, let the liar pay the price! Is the price reasonable? Brand-new high-value electronic products are significantly lower than the market price. First ask, "How does the seller make money?" If you can't answer, skip it. Whether the account is trustworthy: Newly registered accounts, no historical reviews, and updates that all contain copied copy of "Arrived safely" should be crossed out directly. Whether the receipt is controllable: If you can use the platform to guarantee the transaction, do not transfer it privately; try to accept the express delivery in person in person, and do not let the package stay overnight at the post station; if you find an abnormality in the receipt, fix the evidence as soon as possible instead of keeping silent. For low-priced and high-value goods on Xianyu, as long as the logistics sign for it but you don’t get the goods, you can directly follow the above steps to check the source of the package, check the station monitoring, and check the recipient. As long as you are truthful, no liar can escape! Be vigilant, stay away from all types of borderline purchases, protect the safety of your personal property, and never give money to scammers!

If the other party can never explain the purpose of the funds, but repeatedly urges you to invest more, they are not helping you make money at all, but trying to find ways to make money from you! items.title: You never win when you go to a lottery shop to buy scratch-offs? Revealing the huge profit trap of black-produced "micro-scratch codes" that screen out winning tickets in advance
items.core: Go to a lottery shop to buy scratch tickets, scratch off dozens or even hundreds of tickets but not even get a small prize? Think it's just bad luck? Don't be naive - in the black and gray lottery industry, there is an extremely hidden routine of "looking at the code to select the winning ticket", and unscrupulous merchants can make millions of dollars a year.
body: Explanation: Go to a lottery shop to buy scratch tickets, scratch off dozens or even hundreds of tickets but not even get a small prize? Think you just have bad luck? Stop being so naive as to think this is just a matter of probability! In the black and gray lottery production circles, there is an extremely hidden routine of "looking at the code to select the winning ticket"! Some unscrupulous merchants screen out winning tickets in advance by slightly scratching specific locations on lottery tickets, and sell "wasted tickets" that are clearly not winning tickets to ordinary consumers at high prices, making millions of dollars a year! Many people don’t know that scratch-off lottery tickets are designed to have fixed alphabetical or numerical codes printed on specific points in the scratch-off area to facilitate system identification or anti-counterfeiting. Some codes directly represent "not winning"! Unscrupulous merchants take advantage of this loophole and use professional tools to gently rub off an extremely small amount of paint on a specific location on the lottery ticket (only the code point is exposed). The winning lottery tickets are picked up by the merchants themselves or resold at high prices; while those lottery tickets that have been scratched and confirmed as "not winning" are sold to customers as new and intact tickets. Camouflage wear and tear: The location of paint peeling is very small and extremely hidden. When purchasing, ordinary consumers will only think that it is normal friction and collision during transportation and will not think much about it! This kind of routine is hidden from individual customers, and it is even more fatal for customers who "purchase the whole book" or make large purchases for company gatherings! Merchants will package a large number of "scratch tickets" and sell them to large buyers. There was a time when a consumer purchased scratch tickets worth tens of thousands of dollars at a time, only to find that none of them won the prize because they were all screened waste tickets! "What I'm selling is obviously a real lottery ticket issued by a legitimate organization, so why is it illegal?" Don't take such ridiculous chances! Although the lottery ticket itself is genuine, the merchant deliberately conceals the truth that "the lottery ticket has been screened and clearly does not win the prize", sells it to consumers at a high price in the name of "unopened random lottery ticket", and illegally takes possession of other people's property. This is a standard fraud according to the law! High-voltage red line starting at ten years: According to my country's Criminal Law, anyone who defrauds public or private property in an extremely large amount (more than 500,000 yuan) shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of more than ten years or life imprisonment! If the amount involved reaches millions of dollars, you will directly face extremely severe criminal sanctions! Observe the coating carefully: Before purchasing, carefully check whether the coating is smooth, especially whether there are minor scratches, peeling paint or scratches on the edges and specific points. Refuse to buy worn lottery tickets: Any lottery tickets found to have any abnormal wear on the coating will be refused to be purchased and asked to be replaced on the spot! Face-to-face ticket inspection for large-amount purchases: When purchasing the whole book or large-amount purchases, check the integrity of the seals and coatings on the spot. If you find that the entire lottery ticket has abnormal scratches, immediately retain the evidence and report it to the lottery issuing agency or the public security agency! Don’t be greedy for convenience, be careful when buying scratch tickets, and don’t let unscrupulous merchants empty your wallet! If you find a suspicious coating abnormality, check it on the spot and don’t consider yourself unlucky.

If you wait until you are unwilling to pay any more, the other party will directly block you and disappear completely. This type of scammer takes advantage of the victim's mentality that "the amount of money defrauded is not large, and they are embarrassed to call the police because it is "online dating, payment on behalf of others"!" However, the police reminded that this constituted an extremely bad telecommunications network fraud crime: the crime was committed by a gang and the amount involved was extremely huge (more than 1.1 million yuan for 17 people in 3 months). According to the "Criminal Law", the main criminals will face fixed-term imprisonment of more than ten years or life imprisonment! The payment order cannot be found in the official APP on your mobile phone, so don’t pay a penny! items.title: Spend 20,000 yuan to buy scratch tickets and win zero prizes? Revealing the illegal chain of counterfeit lottery shops that renovate dead tickets with stickers costing just a few cents
items.core: After scratching off 20,000 yuan of scratch-off tickets at the company’s annual meeting, you didn’t even get a small prize of 5 yuan? The official return rate is 50%~65%, and there must be small prizes throughout the book. Winning zero prizes is almost impossible in terms of probability! A black-hearted shop secretly shaved off the winning tickets at night, and used stickers for a few cents to renovate the "dead tickets" into new ones and sell them again. Some people made a net profit of more than 800,000 in a single month!
body: Explanation: "The company purchased 20,000 yuan worth of scratch-off tickets as a bonus at the company's annual meeting. After dozens of them were opened and scratched, there was only a pile of scrapings left on the table - not to mention the big prize, not even a small prize of 5 yuan. The 20,000 yuan was wasted!" Wake up! This is not a matter of luck at all! For officially issued instant lottery tickets, the official reward rate is usually between 50% and 65%, and the entire lottery will be equipped with a fixed proportion of small prizes. Scratching 20,000 yuan of tickets at once but "zero winning" is almost impossible in terms of probability! Normal store commissions are only 6% to 8%, but some unscrupulous stores rely on a few cents to turn lottery stores into cash machines with a net profit of more than 800,000 yuan in a single month, and they can only get in and out! After the whole box of new scratch-off tickets arrives, the unscrupulous shopkeeper will operate in private after closing the door at night: quietly scratch the coating of the prize area to check, pick out all the lottery tickets with prizes inside, and use them to scan the codes to redeem the prizes. The remaining waste tickets that do not win at all are called "dead tickets" in the industry. If you just throw away the "dead ticket", the shop owner will have to bear the loss of buying the ticket. So they found illegal channels to customize high-imitation "scratch-off stickers", and the cost per piece was as low as a few cents! The operation technique is extremely skillful: align the imitation coating to the scraped position, compact it with a scraper, and then use a hot air gun to heat it slightly to fit it. The appearance of the repaired lottery ticket is almost the same as that of the new lottery ticket, and it is difficult for ordinary consumers to distinguish it with the naked eye! Many people will ask: Isn’t the lottery ticket scanned online? This is the most insidious loophole in this routine: the instant lottery system will only trigger online registration and write-off when "winning and redeeming the prize, scanning the QR code in the security area"! As for these "dead tickets" that did not win the prize, the customer scratched them open and threw them into the trash can after seeing that they had missed the prize. There was no way to go through the process of scanning the code to redeem the prize. The official backend naturally could not recognize that the ticket had been opened and refurbished - just like a bottle of drink was drunk, filled with white water, resealed and put back on the shelf. As long as no one goes to test, the backend will never know that the bottle has been tampered with! There has even been an underground network specializing in "film refurbishment and cross-store allocation and supply". By repeatedly selling dead tickets with zero redemption cost, one group's monthly net profit has directly reached more than 800,000! On a daily basis, the ratio of "30% genuine tickets + 70% refurbished dead tickets" is used to sell them. Individual customers occasionally win a small prize of ten or twenty yuan, and no one is suspicious at all. It wasn't until he met a big customer who made a one-time purchase of 20,000 yuan that the store owner greedily wanted to take advantage of the opportunity to clear out the backlog of refurbished dead tickets. As a result, the entire batch was stuffed with dead tickets and the winning rate dropped to zero. This revealed his flaws! When the unscrupulous shop owner was caught, he even claimed that "he just put a new layer of film on it." But legally, the core subject of lottery sales is the "chance to win". Knowing that it is 100% impossible to win the lottery, but using the film to disguise the used tickets as brand new lottery tickets and selling them at the original price, this is a definite crime of fraud! Those who make huge amounts will directly face fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years! Three tips to spot the "renewed film ticket": First, look at the scraping feel - the scraping of the original coating is fine and dry. There is self-adhesive underneath the refurbished film. Scratching will lift the whole piece or even pull out the sticky glue; second, touch the edge of the coating - side light Or use your fingernails to gently pick around the scratching area. The original ink transition is smooth, and the secondary film has an obvious "step feel" or heating bubbles. Three warnings for online "second-hand blind boxes" - "weighing by jin, unscratched final tickets" in the live broadcast room are all the hardest hit areas! Unpack the entire package on the spot after purchasing it: Be sure to ask the store clerk to open the entire package of new tickets with the official plastic sealing film and batch number in person, and never accept pieces that have been separated and put together together! Scrape out the rubber thread and collect evidence immediately: Once you find that the coating is sticky, peeling, or the rubber thread falls off, or the whole book is abnormally "zero winning", do not throw away the ticket, keep all lottery tickets and payment records immediately, call 110 directly to call the police and report to the sports lottery/welfare lottery center!

Today, I will take you to thoroughly sort out and uncover this set of deceptive tricks entrenched in the "private fitting room", and see clearly how they evolve step by step and harvest the noobs! The early routines were very rudimentary and mainly relied on the "shopping companion service" in the mall: accompanying you when shopping, buying clothes, and helping you match your style. After making private transfers and payments, their attitude immediately changes 180 degrees and they don't care much. At this time, the prototype of "one-to-one image consultant" packaging began to appear. With the supervision of the platform, they began to change venues, and the terms "door-to-door dressing" and "private fitting" began to sprout: renting an apartment or office building, focusing on "personal customization, exclusive services, and good privacy." The agency operates a private studio in the name of clothing matching and image design, charging by the hour. The so-called "senior stylist" charges thousands of dollars an hour, and provides fake personal profiles, case presentations and customer reviews. Thanks to the maturity of social platforms, various fringe studios have begun to explode: scammers create "beautiful stylist" personas, publish a large number of dress-up videos, use seemingly formal dressing services as a cover, and divert traffic to private WeChat through private messages. The "glorious period" of the part-time group has arrived at the same time - "high salary every day, easy money, just know how to dress" recruitment information floods the screen, specifically looking for young girls who are in urgent need of money. Implementation of the transaction: arrange for girls to come to your home or in a closed studio to have personal interactions on the grounds of "measurement and sorting clothes". After negotiating the price, they will directly enter the underground pornographic transaction. With the rise of AI technology, the cost of committing crimes for scammers has been directly reduced to zero: for a few dollars, you can generate realistic photos of beautiful women, videos of dressing up and customer reviews, and create fake personas in batches, making them extremely difficult to detect. It even uses AI face-changing and AI voice technology to generate fake videos and voices that can deceive identity confirmation on the phone. Using a "low-price trial class" worth tens of yuan to induce customers to add WeChat, and then gradually upgrading to private services worth several thousand yuan, the logic of diverting traffic to the private domain through social platforms has been completely solved. Routines are still changing. In the past two years, "remote guidance", "online private lessons" and other variant routines have appeared frequently. As long as the victim can be diverted to WeChat or third-party software, various deceptive projects will have various diversion tricks, making it difficult for people to guard against. Pitfalls faced by consumers: money being defrauded - being blackmailed directly after paying a deposit or a large service fee; extortion (immortal jump) - in a completely closed apartment or hotel without surveillance, it is extremely easy to encounter gangs setting up a trap to extort huge amounts of money using "sneak photography" as a threat; public security penalties - once you cross the red line and participate in underground illegal transactions, you will face arrest and a criminal record! The pitfalls faced by job-seeking girls: The high-paying and easy "part-time job as a escort" is just a bait. In a private studio, under the pressure of the environment and the temptation of high tips, it is easy to be brainwashed and semi-forced to lose the bottom line, become a tool for illegal wealth-making, and even face legal sanctions! Never leave public places: Any normal image transformation and dressing services should be carried out in public and supervised commercial places. Anyone who emphasizes "private door-to-door, one-on-one, personal service in a confined space" and charges extremely high fees is 100% a scam! Be wary of "easy and high-paying part-time jobs": don't believe any part-time job that "you can make thousands a day just by shopping and dressing." There is no free lunch in the world, and all the gifts given by fate have already been marked with a secret price.

items.core: "You spent 10,000 to 20,000 yuan to trick an elderly man in rural areas into selling their rooftop photovoltaic equipment, and then made a huge profit of more than 100,000 yuan from one sale"? The most vicious thing about this black industry is that it uses extremely low prices to deceive unsuspecting rural elderly people into becoming "thieves" or "appropriators", allowing them to take the blame for the illegal industry. It is understood that a large number of elderly people have been sued by photovoltaic companies and are facing huge claims of more than 100,000 or 200,000 yuan. In some places (such as Suqian, Shuyang and other places), the police have launched a heavy attack and arrested hundreds of people! In rural areas now, there are many formal photovoltaic installation teams and investment companies. They signed an agreement with the farmer: the farmer is only responsible for "renting out the roof" and getting rent. The entire set of photovoltaic power generation equipment worth hundreds of thousands will be installed by the investment company, and the ownership will be 100% owned by the company. Although the name of the final grid connection record was written as a farmer, ordinary people only have the right to "collect rent" and have no right to dispose of the equipment at all. Older people often don’t understand complex contract details, which leaves opportunities for scammers to take advantage of them. Scammers carry gifts into the village, targeting left-behind elderly people. They would point to the roof and say, "Look, the name on which this equipment is connected to the grid is yours, so it is your property! It won't make any money if you keep it here, so why not sell it to me and I will give you ten thousand or twenty thousand at a time!" In order to reassure the elderly, they would also take out a very serious "Photovoltaic Module Sales Contract" and ask the illiterate and illegal elderly to sign it. As soon as the old man lets go, the scammer will organize people as quickly as possible to dismantle the complete set of photovoltaic panels, inverters and other equipment worth hundreds of thousands on the roof, load it into trucks, and transport it away. Amazing profits: The discounted price offered by scammers to the elderly for the photovoltaic panels dismantled in this way is extremely low. One panel only costs tens to one hundred yuan. However, through secondary sales, they can sell one panel for more than 300 yuan! The entire set of equipment collected for 20,000 yuan can be resold for hundreds of thousands, and it is a waste of money! When the old man was secretly happy with the 10,000 to 20,000 yuan "grocery money", the real disaster had just begun. Plaintiffs come calling, facing hundreds of thousands of claims: investment companies soon discover the equipment is missing and come calling. The original installation agreement was clearly written and the equipment belonged to the company. Now that the old man has sold an asset that does not belong to him, the contract has been directly breached, and the old man will face huge compensation of more than 100,000 or even 200,000 yuan! Suspected of the crime of theft or embezzlement: Selling the property knowingly that it is not yours, or even cooperating with others to demolish it, is suspected of committing the crime of theft or embezzlement! The scammer even comforted the elderly in the video and voice: "This is considered a civil dispute at most. As long as you don't pay back the money, you won't go to jail." - This is pure fart! This is not only a criminal offense, but once the scammer takes the goods and runs away, all legal liabilities and compensation must be borne by the old man who stays where he is! Because this scam has seriously damaged rural revitalization projects that benefit farmers and has extremely negative social impacts, police in many places have begun to use police officers in other places to crack down with iron fists - hundreds of people involved in the case have been subject to criminal coercive measures in Shuyang, Suqian, Jiangsu and other places! "Maochi" is a hardware device that can insert dozens or even hundreds of mobile phone cards at the same time. items.title: The subject had three printers and refused to allow photos to be taken, and he said he was trying to get on the wrong side of the law? Reveal the secret of the black production line of color printing and the accomplice trap that draws you into the gang!
items.core: Three printers, continuous color ink supply, not allowed to take photos, claiming to be "on the edge of the law", keeping an eye on the U-coin market, asking for overseas Apple IDs to install paper airplanes, and even saying that I will take you with me when it is ready - this is not a new side business, but a black production line for counterfeiting currency and valuable documents. What really kills you is not what she prints, but that you are already standing at the door of an accomplice.
body: Explanation: "She has been very mysterious recently. I don't know where she got three printers. The small boxes hanging next to them contained colored materials, and she didn't let me take pictures. I asked what they were for, and she said don't worry about it. I asked if this was what her new job was, and she said yes, to clean the edges. I asked what kind of printers, and she said to clean the legal edges. She also asked me to help her register a US-area Apple. ID, she said she wanted to download something, and she usually stared at something like the stock market, which was U. Finally, she said, "When she finishes it, take me with you." - If this passage makes you feel something is wrong, your intuition is right. This is not a new sideline business, this is a complete black production assembly line, and she has already reserved a place for you. Printing shops, advertising companies, e-commerce marking, and label workshops may all have three machines, so the quantity alone cannot explain the problem. What really changes is the configuration and attitude: There is no need for an external continuous ink supply system for home or ordinary commercial use. Color ink is dispensed by bottles and consumed by the day. This is a typical batch color output configuration; multiple machines are not for speed, but to share different processes and different formats, running the front and back at the same time, or one machine is dedicated to the main body pattern and the other is dedicated to variable information. Coupled with the fact that "you are not allowed to take pictures and are not allowed to approach", there is no reason to do this in a serious business - printing people are most afraid that others will not know that they are printing. Ordinary people think that taking photos is just to "keep a souvenir", but in the logic of case handling, a photo can lock in far more things than imagined: the printer brand and model, the serial number of the machine, the batch and texture of the paper, the brand of ink or toner, and the stacking method of the finished product. Everything can match the upstream supply and downstream shipment. This kind of case is not solved by confession, but by the "still life" at the scene. She blocked your camera, which shows that she knows what it will mean once these things are leaked out - a project that does not even allow photos to be taken can never be a legitimate business. These three things are inconspicuous when viewed individually, but together they are the standard operation method of black industry. First, USDT (commonly known as U) is a universal settlement currency produced by the black industry. It reaches accounts point-to-point and does not go through bank transactions. It is exponentially more difficult for the police to trace the capital chain. She is staring at the "quotes like the stock market", which shows that she is concerned about the repayment and exchange rate. This is an action only a business person would do. Second, Telegram has long been removed from domestic app stores. If you want to install it, you must use an overseas Apple ID. Therefore, the real meaning of the sentence "help me register a US ID" is "help me install the order-taking tool." Third, Paper Plane is the order-taking hall for this type of business: templates, supplies, finished products, and buyers are all matched in the group. When recruiting people for illegal businesses, they never talk about risks, they only talk about "making money together." But the threshold for joint crime is much lower than most people imagine: knowing that the other party is doing illegal things, but still providing account numbers, equipment, venues, raw materials, transportation, and settlement, constitutes an accomplice, and she will be convicted and sentenced according to the crime she committed. The step of "registering an overseas ID" is particularly fatal - the real name of the account is you, the device you log in to is you, and the mobile phone number bound to it is yours. The police will follow the account to check, and the first person they lock is you, not her. In her eyes, you are not a partner, but an insurance company. This kind of combination of "color printing and concealment" usually falls in five directions: first, counterfeiting currency (RMB or foreign currency), which carries the heaviest penalty; second, counterfeiting state agency documents and official documents (ID card, household registration, real estate certificate, business license, red-headed document), which is called a certificate in the industry; third, having Price tickets and invoices (VAT invoices, fixed-amount invoices, concert tickets, stamps, air itineraries); fourth, forging registered trademarks (fake wine labels, fake cosmetics labels, anti-counterfeiting stickers, fake medicine packaging); fifth, supporting props for fraud (fake contracts, fake official seals, fake wanted orders...

Routine: 1️⃣ The printer itself is neutral, but "three plus color ink tanks and no one can see it" changes the nature 🖨️ 2️⃣ The real reason why she is not allowed to take pictures: She is shielding physical evidence, not being shy 📵 3️⃣ Watching the U-money market, asking for overseas ID, and using paper airplanes: a complete closed loop of order taking and settlement 📱 4️⃣ "I'll take you with me when we're done": This sentence is the really dangerous part 🕸️

Law: "Criminal Law" Article 170 The crime of counterfeiting currency, if the circumstances are particularly serious, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment; Article 171 The crime of selling, purchasing, and transporting counterfeit currency; Article 206 The crime of forging and selling forged special value-added tax invoices, if the quantity is huge, the punishment shall be not less than ten years or life imprisonment; Article 209 The crime of illegally manufacturing invoices; Article 227 The crime of counterfeiting and reselling counterfeit valuable documents (tickets, boat tickets, stamps, etc.); Article 280 The crime of forging, altering, and trading official documents and seals of state agencies; Article 215 The crime of illegally manufacturing registered trademarks. The above-mentioned crimes all punish acts of assistance, and those who provide accounts, equipment, venues, transportation, and settlement will be punished as accomplices.

There is no serious business in the world that needs to be hidden from you, and there is no legal business that requires you to register an account to start it.

Someone asks you to register an overseas ID, buy consumables on your behalf, collect U-coins on your behalf, or pick up express delivery on your behalf. They say that these are just trivial matters. In essence, they are asking you to be an accomplice, not a helper.
To judge the nature, only look at three things: special paper consumables, post-processing equipment, and stacks of finished products of the same denomination. If any of them appear, stay away.
Forgery crimes are completed as soon as they are printed, and whether they are sold or not does not affect the conviction. The sentence "I did not know" is almost impossible to establish in judicial determination.

body: Explanation: There is a seemingly simple and fair "street dice" game on the market, which is disguised by scammers as a welfare project with "extremely high returns". Today, let’s dismantle this dark and gray chess game that seems to be a sure win but actually has deadly tricks! The operation of this type of game is extremely simple, and the entry threshold is usually set at 100 yuan for 10 rounds: On the surface, except for square 27, which represents a loss, the other squares are all marked with generous bonuses. It seems that "you can win back your capital no matter how you play." Do you think you can pick it up by luck? In fact, the background probabilities have long been played by actuaries: no matter you choose clockwise or counterclockwise, the grid on the board is marked with a high bonus of several thousand yuan. In mathematical calculations, the probability of combining the points of 5 dice is 0, and you absolutely cannot land on it! The grand prize is purely a cover to attract passers-by to watch. There are a total of 7,776 combinations of 5 dices. After adding the two-choice direction, the combinations soar to 15,552: According to mathematical expectation calculation, the average player who participated in the game in a single time lost 297 yuan! After playing 10 consecutive rounds, the cumulative average loss was as high as 2,970 yuan! Under the law of large numbers, there is no chance of winning money by chance. This type of street dice game is essentially a gambling trap that has undergone rigorous mathematical calculations: when you win money, it arouses greed and induces you to keep increasing your bets; after losing money, it uses your unwillingness to stimulate you to continue to make more money. Over time, it is easy to fall into a bottomless pit! If you encounter such a "high-return" dice stall on the street, please take a detour and don't join in the fun!

items.core: You don’t need to pay a penny for tuition. The manufacturer directly brings you into the e-commerce business and helps you generate orders throughout the process. You can make a profit without losing money when opening a store! The only cooperation model is 50/50 store profit. "
body: Explanation: "Without a penny of tuition, the manufacturer directly brings you into the e-commerce business, helps you get orders throughout the process, and you can make a profit without losing anything when opening a store! The only cooperation model is 50% of the store profit." Are you excited when you hear about this "zero-risk, high-return" project? Don’t rush into e-commerce dreams yet. What’s hidden behind this is a well-designed serial fraud trap! Today we are going to deeply dismantle this so-called "zero-tuition e-commerce" get-rich-quick scheme to see how outrageous it is: Black production parasitism: Huihui claims to be the manufacturer of a certain product through short videos, live broadcasts, etc., and uses the excuse of expanding product sales to attract some entrepreneurs who are eager to make money to do e-commerce with the gimmick of "free e-commerce, free sales, and guaranteed profits when opening a store." Low stakes and low vigilance: Novices often feel that they don’t have to pay tuition, there are no entry risks, and the other party can’t make money if they don’t place orders, so it’s impossible to be cheated. So he followed the opponent into the game without any precautions, but he didn't know that he was playing into the opponent's hands. 🐑 Low-price paving the way: Huihui will help you handle the relevant procedures for opening a store and successfully put their products on the shelves. Then, on the grounds that the weight of the new store is low and the store experience needs to be improved, you can sell it at a low price in the early stage and lose a few dollars per order. Creating illusions: After you place hundreds of orders, Huihui will tell you to bring the price back to the regular price, and the store will explode. When Xiaobai heard what he said made sense, he happily accepted the early losses for the sake of long-term interests. 🛍️ Crazy urging: Late one night while you were sleeping, Huihui hired a large number of trolls to go to your store and place crazy orders! You will be surprised to find that the store is happy to place thousands of orders the next day! Urging for the loan: At this time, Huihui will come over and tell you that my brother has a huge order. Give me the payment and arrange the delivery immediately. Xiaobai was so immersed in his dream of getting rich that he didn't even bother to verify the authenticity of the order and just transferred the payment. 🎨 Cash out and run away: After receiving the payment, they will immediately cash it out into RMB through private channels. After completing an order, immediately abandon the account, change to a new account, a new IP, a new real name, and continue to cheat. The ending of the abandoned store: The most terrifying thing is that if you transfer the payment, the subsequent store will no longer have any natural traffic or real orders, and it will completely become an abandoned store. After this wave of operations, after excluding the actual costs and marketing expenses, Huihui made thousands of dollars per order! 🔄 Don’t be greedy and take other evil ways: On the surface, it seems to be taking advantage of loopholes in the rules to “get huge sales with zero tuition fees”, but in essence, it is a naked illegal crime. The law severely punishes you: we must be sternly reminded that no matter who the victim is, as long as you fabricate facts, forge documents, and possess other people's property by illegal means, it will 100% constitute a crime of fraud! Opening a store is also a pitfall: all e-commerce projects that claim to have zero threshold, zero risk, and guaranteed profits will end up in legal trials and long prison lives. Stay awake, take the right path to seek development, and don’t lose the big for the small! 💪✨

items.title: Revealing the secret of the second-hand platform "Secret Coin": a dime coin with a price of 300, an inducement scam that attracted 300,000 in two months
items.core: A dime coin was listed on a second-hand platform with a price tag of 300 yuan. Not only did the buyers come in an endless stream, but they also became dumb after receiving the coin and did not dare to say anything..."
body: Explanation: "The one-cent coin is listed on the second-hand platform with a price of 300 yuan. Not only are there an endless stream of buyers, but after receiving the coin, they are dumb and eat Coptis chinensis. They dare not say anything..." This is not an ancient coin collection, but a "coin code" scam carefully designed using human luck and gray fantasy! How does this kind of trick trap buyers? It is mainly divided into four steps: Obscure listing: Put ordinary dime coins on the second-hand platform with a price tag of 300 yuan or more. Inducement copy: Add highly suggestive text (such as "1994 and 1997 were in excellent condition, distributed nationwide, and also available after 2000"). Use the "code word" rumors of certain products on second-hand platforms to induce buyers to think of gray transactions. 🪙 Create an atmosphere: When a buyer inquires, the seller has an ambiguous tone and does not answer directly, deliberately creating a sense of mystery that "everyone knows everything and there is sufficient supply". Impulsiveness: Driven by their own desires and luck, the buyer thinks he has discovered some kind of secret doorway and completely loses his mind. 💬 Installment scam: The seller requires a "deposit link" of 300 yuan first, and promises to "confirm receipt of the goods after delivery, and pay the balance if you are satisfied with the goods." Confirm receipt in seconds: In order to get the so-called "special goods" as soon as possible, buyers often click "Confirm receipt" impatiently right after the goods are shipped, and transfer the money directly into the seller's pocket. 💳 Authentic delivery: When the buyer applied for a refund without waiting for the expected "special service", the seller directly refused and conveniently sent an ordinary coin worth ten cents. The dumb man eats Coptis chinensis: The buyer discovered that he had been deceived after receiving the coins, but because his motives were impure and he was wronged first, he did not dare to speak out. He complained to the platform, and the seller did deliver the "1999 dime coins" as ordered, and there was no violation of the regulations according to the voucher. 📦 Information gap trap: Sellers use "compliant products (coins)" as a cover, and use tacit code words to allow buyers to complete illegal associations in their minds. Guilty mentality: The buyer has a "ghost in his heart" and voluntarily gives up on basic transaction vigilance, selectively believes in the so-called secret backdoor, and is ultimately accurately harvested! When you think you have discovered some kind of secret backdoor, you have actually walked into a trap tailor-made for you. Maintain a healthy mentality and stay away from gray temptations! 💪✨ There are scams everywhere on the Internet and scammers emerge in endlessly! Pay attention to this channel, we will always protect you!

Routine: 1️⃣ Step 1: Code word packaging, fictional gray illusion 2️⃣ Step 2: Pretending to be mysterious, guiding private transactions 3️⃣ Step 3: Collecting deposit in advance, inducing early confirmation 4️⃣ Step 4: Compliant delivery, completely cheating
Chapter: 📊 Analyzing the essence of routines
When shopping on second-hand platforms, you need to clearly see the physical pictures and description details of the products
Products with prices that obviously deviate from the value are mostly inducing fraud
If the goods received are not consistent, immediately apply for platform intervention, do not confirm the receipt easily

Case: Someone sold a "dime coin" with a price of 300 yuan on a second-hand platform, and the product description implied that it was a "special year collection coin". Buyers receive ordinary coins after taking the photo. Because the amount is small and it is difficult to prove, most people consider themselves unlucky. The seller made an illegal profit of 300,000 yuan in two months through this routine.

Then, on the pretext of "setting up exclusive targeted high commissions", they defrauded the unique identifier "UID" of the blogger's account. Merchant brand: When looking for cooperation, be sure to strictly review the qualifications of the organization and experts, and follow the official formal process 🛡️!
Verify the identity of the other party through official channels before cooperation. The brand will not require the merchant to pay the sample fee first.
Reject the transfer request from the "two-way intermediary" role, and all funds must be traded through a guaranteed platform.
Be alert immediately when encountering the "high commission + urgent order" rhetoric. You can ask the other party to provide proof of qualifications before communicating.

items.title: If you want to make money, you must first look at what you have: connections, funds, and abilities. If you are missing one piece, you have to make up for it.
items.core: If there are none of the three, then the most realistic state at this stage may be:
body: Explanation: Many people are always asking: Breaking the question apart, there are actually three things that cannot be escaped: Network. funds. ability. You must have at least one in hand to truly seize the opportunity. If you don't have all three, then the most realistic state at this stage may be: go to work. Deliver food. Work as a security guard. Work and save money. This is not unusual. What really matters is: Have you slowly made up for what you are missing outside of your current life? 1. Network: It’s not about how many people you know, but who is willing to help you at critical times. There are thousands of people in your address book. There may not be anyone who can truly provide resources, opportunities, and information. Really valuable connections generally come from: long-term cooperation. Do things together. Stable output value. Trust each other. So networking is not about “adding a few bosses on WeChat”. Rather: Do you have something worth remembering? 2. Funds: Money is not everything, but many opportunities do require principal 💰 You understand some projects. But there is no start-up capital. Still can't get in. Therefore, one of the most practical tasks for ordinary people in the early stage is: first establish a cash reserve. Even if your current income is not high, you can first: Control your expenses. Accumulate principal. Learn low-cost skills. Start a legitimate little side hustle. Because the biggest risk for people without capital is: as soon as they see the so-called "low-threshold get-rich-quick project", it is easy to rush in immediately. 3. Ability: This is the easiest thing for ordinary people to make up for themselves. Compared with connections and capital, ability is the most controllable. For example: live broadcast. Clip. Sale. operations. Get customers. Write copy. Do e-commerce. Local life. As long as you are willing to continue investing time, you can slowly accumulate. So even if a person is just working as a security guard, delivering food, or working part-time, it doesn't mean that he can only do this forever. Work during the day. Learn skills at night. Make content on weekends. Over the long term, career paths can change completely. 4. The problem is not "playing games", but whether the time is aligned with the goal 🎮 One person said: But every free time is used to: play the king. Watch short videos. Stay up late talking. In fact, dreams and actions are not connected at all. It’s not that there can’t be entertainment. But if the goal is really big, you have to set aside a fixed amount of time for the goal. For example: Learn skills for 1 hour every day. Post one piece of content every day. Contact several potential clients every day. Review business once a day. This is called "matching goals and actions." 5. The path for ordinary people to turn over is usually not a sudden takeoff. In reality, it is more like: working part-time → learning skills → taking small orders → accumulating customers → having stable side income → then considering transformation. Instead of: No money today. I’ll come across a project tomorrow. The day after tomorrow, you will directly earn one million per year. The income that can really be retained for a long time is usually accumulated layer by layer. 6. Why is “direction” more important than the effort itself? Because it also takes three years. Some people have been repeating the same low-value labor for three years. Some people have been accumulating skills for three years. client. account. work. Industry experience. After a few years, the gap between the two people may be very large. So what is really worth observing is: Will what you do now leave compound interest? Things that will be reset to zero after finishing today. After finishing today, you can continue to accumulate things tomorrow. The long term is not an outcome at all. 7. The story of Shen Wansan is not really about "who is richer." In historical stories, Shen Wansan is often portrayed as a businessman who was extremely wealthy. Zhu Yuanzhang represents another kind of power: power. Resource mobilization. Organizational skills. No matter how the film and television works are presented, what is really worth watching for this kind of story is actually a reality: simply...
Chapter: "How do ordinary people turn around?" "I want to make money." "I want to turn over." "This project used to be very profitable."
Sort out existing resources: list the contacts around you, mark areas for cooperation, and select entry points that can be monetized.
Use 1 month to learn a basic skill, such as short video editing, and first accept low-price orders to accumulate cases and experience.
Start with a small business with less than 500 yuan, such as setting up a stall to sell seasonal commodities, and test the market reaction before making adjustments.

Case: Xiao Wang wants to make money as a side business, but he has neither connections, funds, nor professional skills. He blindly followed the trend and opened a store. Because he didn't understand product selection and operation, he couldn't sell the goods and lost 20,000 yuan. Later, he worked part-time to learn e-commerce operations, accumulated experience and customers, and then started again, gradually stabilizing profits.

Explanation: Everyone says that e-commerce is difficult to do now, but there is a group of black industry gangs who use Xianyu and JD.com’s official APP to play a four-step rogue routine of “paying for goods without supply”, specifically targeting students who have just finished the college entrance examination and are about to buy computers, as well as people who like to pick up goods at low prices on second-hand platforms! The most amazing thing is that after you click on this link, your phone will automatically jump to and wake up the real JD.com official APP on your phone. The product payment interface and official coupon page are all authentic! Step 3: Extreme psychological pressure to force you to pay hastily ⏰ Just when you confirm that it is an official APP and relax your vigilance, the scammer starts to urge you frantically: "This limited-time coupon is only valid for 5 minutes, and it will be invalid when it expires!" Under the psychological pressure of the 5-minute countdown, and because you think it is an official platform, you have no time to carefully verify the underlying information of the order, so you just click to pay. Step 4: Server delay, "serial smoke bomb" will stabilize you 🌫️ After paying, you can't find the order in your JD.com APP. At this time, the scammer has already prepared his words: "There is a delay in the official server. You can see it after refreshing in an hour. The money has gone to JD.com anyway, so you can rest assured." The purpose is to delay time and prevent you from calling the police or intercepting funds in time. Why can’t I find the order after I paid the money and entered the official platform? Because that link is not a product ordering link at all, but a hidden "payment link"! 🔗 After clicking on the link, the bound order recipient, phone number and address are all filled in by the scammer. They have only one purpose: to induce you to actively cancel your refund application! As long as you feel soft-hearted and click Cancel, you will completely lose the opportunity for the platform to intervene. The scammer will still collect money and you will still lose everything! This operation seems smart and cost-free, but it has seriously violated the law. A piece of information can be sold for a few cents! Some courier insiders take advantage of the "reprint the receipt" permission in the system (originally used to reprint the receipt when it is damaged or lost) to directly enter the order number to find out the complete name, phone number and detailed house number. items.core: The content of this issue is not to create panic, but to let every parent see clearly: What does the current danger look like? How on earth should we protect our children?
body: Note: The content of this issue is not to create panic, but to let every parent see clearly: What does the current danger look like? How on earth should we protect our children? As technology evolves, the illegal methods of child trafficking and information leakage are becoming more and more subtle. Here are 4 new faces that all parents must be wary of! In the past, dealers used to do things secretly in private, but now they move directly to social platforms and group chats! They use code words to avoid platform censorship: Under various "asking for adoption/adoption" posts, people often leave messages saying "I want a baby boy to be born", and then lead to a private message chat, asking for a "thank you fee" of hundreds of thousands or more. What's more, under the guise of "love adoption", they are actually engaging in human trafficking! The state has clear regulations that adoption must go through the civil affairs department. It is illegal for any individual to collect money for private adoption! If you believe it, you will jump into the pit. If you see this kind of information, please take a screenshot and save it, and call 96110 or 110 directly to report it! Traffickers no longer go to the streets to randomly look for targets, but specifically search online for pregnant women who have difficulty raising children (such as financial difficulties, unmarried pregnancy, etc.). They pretend to be sincere and kind-hearted people who "want to adopt because they are infertile". Once they gain trust and get the child, they sell it at several times the price! There have been cases before: criminals used this routine to defraud and sell three infants and young children in less than a year, making a profit of more than 130,000 yuan. If anyone around you has the idea of ​​placing a child for adoption or adoption, be sure to advise them to contact the local civil affairs department or the Women's Federation through formal channels. Anyone who actively claims to be "available for adoption" in private messages online is most likely a liar! Some people use AI to generate false missing persons notices, fabricating news about "a child being abducted" and adding photos of children online to make it look real. After being posted to the short video platform, it attracted a large number of enthusiastic netizens to forward it, and the number of fans on the account instantly increased. This kind of fraud not only wastes police resources and public goodwill, but also causes unnecessary panic and even drowns out information about missing children who really need help! What's more, there are even high-cost payphone calls attached to engage in fraud. When you see a missing child seeking help online, first check whether the publisher is certified through official channels (such as the Ministry of Public Security's Missing Children Information Release Platform). I would rather not repost a missing person notice without official endorsement than add chaos! Some illegal workers squat in front of the school to take pictures of the license plate number of the pick-up and drop-off cars, and spend dozens of dollars to check the owner's information; some even illegally purchase the data directly from the inside: name, school, grade, class, and parents' phone numbers are all packaged, and the cheapest is only a dime per piece! When this information is combined, the child's daily activities can be accurately identified (when to go to and from school, which way to go, and which class he is in). The gangsters don't even need to stay down, they can just call out the child's name at the school gate to get close to him! When sharing your baby in Moments, do not expose sensitive information such as school, class, name, etc. Be careful when you are bombarded with sales pitches and ask, "How did you get my information?" If you find a serious leak of information, call the police decisively! Protecting children is the common responsibility of the whole society. Recognize the tricks, stay vigilant, and don’t let our good intentions and negligence leave opportunities for black and gray products to take advantage of! 🙅‍♂️✨

body: Explanation: "Da Liangqian will be changed to your own biological child! "——This is the deceptive saying that the black industry agent is best at. Today, we will completely expose this dark and gray industry chain under the guise of "private paternity testing". Don't let your doubts and fears become a bargaining chip for others to blackmail you repeatedly! For a formal judicial paternity test, both parties must bring their ID cards to the forensic laboratory, take photos, have their fingerprints taken, and have the forensic examiner personally take samples. Only in this way can the report be legally valid. However, black industry intermediaries completely ignore the laws and rules. They only care about how much money you pay: 🏢 Fake dens: Hidden in an ordinary office building, there are signs of "Biotechnology" and "Health Consultation", and there is not even a testing equipment inside. 🗑️ The samples are thrown directly into the trash can: the hair, blood stains, and nails you sent are thrown directly into the trash can after they receive it. 🖨️ Carrot stamp template overprinting: Open the computer to bring up the previous report template, modify the name, date and conclusion, print it out and stamp it with a privately engraved forged official seal, and an "authoritative report" is born! Black industry intermediaries not only make false reports to defraud money, but also lure you into the abyss step by step: 📉 Low-price lure (charges several hundred yuan): Claiming to "protect privacy, no need to be present, and sample delivery", they use a low price of several hundred yuan to trick you into sending samples 💥 Create a crisis and ask for money (charge 2,000 yuan): After you sent the sample, the other party suddenly changed his face and said, "The preliminary test result shows that parent-child relationship is not supported (non-biological relationship)." Your privacy, family conflicts and psychological fears are all commodities that can be traded repeatedly. This kind of illegal and criminal behavior is extremely bad, and it clearly corresponds to multiple felonies in our country's criminal law: several crimes are punished together, and the prison term starts at several years! In recent years, there have been many cases of people being caught forging extortion reports by forging paternity test reports. body: Explanation: A rustic WeChat group that didn’t even have a profile picture of the group leader relied on a rule of “getting people to get cash back” to attract tens of thousands of people in 20 days, and the turnover reached 400,000! The gameplay is extremely simple and crude: pay a membership fee of 29 yuan, and get a cashback of 20 yuan for each person you bring into the group, get back your original investment if you bring two people into the group, and make a net profit if you bring three people in... There is no upper limit! Many job seekers or people who want to make money part-time suddenly think that they are "guaranteed to make money without losing money" and start frantically recruiting relatives, colleagues, and classmates to join the group. But what you don’t know is that every time you pull someone in, an extra amount of money will sink into the group owner’s capital pool. Today, let’s break down the shrewd calculation behind this and see how this “making money” method works! 💸 You pay 29 yuan and get 20 yuan back if you bring someone in. Where did the remaining 9 yuan go? This is not the profit of the group owner, but the reserve fund. Where does the real profit come from? From those who handed over 29 bucks and didn’t get any! Many people thought this was zero-threshold online earning, but found that their relatives and friends scolded MLM as soon as they heard "pay money to join a group to attract people", and it failed to attract people at all. These 29 yuan will be lost directly in the group. If there are 2,000 people out of 10,000 people who cannot be recruited, the group owner will directly make nearly 60,000 yuan in vain! Cashback is never available immediately, and is usually settled at ten o'clock every night. The money for recruiting people today will arrive tomorrow. This time difference means that the group owner will always have a huge "float" in his hands. Every day hundreds of thousands are received and tens of thousands are returned. The net accumulated funds are used by the group owners to open new groups and create new pools. As long as there are more people entering the group than leaving, the pool will not be dry, and the group leader can withdraw the principal at any time! You think you have attracted enough people to recoup your investment and even make money, but the 20 yuan was not given by the group owner, but was cut from the 29 yuan given by the relatives and friends you brought in! body: Explanation: As a 17 or 8-year-old who is about to graduate, you were sent to the factory by the school with great expectations.
