When parents hear that it is "uniformly arranged by the school", they will subconsciously feel that it is formal. So busloads of students were sent to the factory. From this moment on, their graduation certificates became the invisible rope that tied them all. The notices and contracts were full of garish words about "teaching practice" and "professional practice." But once you get to the right place, your style of painting suddenly changes: Those who study design start driving screws every day; those who study computer work frantically moving goods in the warehouse; those who study nursing are directly assigned to the electronics factory. Repeating the same action thousands of times every day, without access to any professional equipment, let alone learning industry techniques. The school talks about "training", but what the factory needs is just a group of young, obedient, ultra-low-cost workers who can work intensive overtime. The factory will not get this group of people for free. This is a "labor business" with a clearly marked price: the factory will settle expenses based on the number of people and working hours. For example, the factory pays 19.5 yuan per hour, but the final salary paid to the students may only be 15 yuan. Of the 4.5 yuan difference, 4 yuan goes to the school and 5 cents goes to the agency. It may seem like the difference between a student and a student is only a few dollars, but in one class and grade, with hundreds of people working in the factory for more than ten hours a day, this difference will immediately turn into hundreds of thousands of huge profits! In the eyes of middlemen, students are no longer here to learn, but a moving "head" that constantly generates profits. Just earning the factory's "capitation fee" and illegal production is not enough. They will even reach out to students: a wide range of fees: internship fees, management fees, accommodation fees, skills training fees... Some students even haven't received a penny of salary when they enter the factory, but instead have to pay thousands of dollars in "training fees." If you work hard for the factory during the day and do calculations at night, you may not even be able to make back the various expenses you paid in the final salary! Long shifts, night shifts and unskilled repetitive work that ordinary employees are unwilling to do are often heaped on interns. More than ten hours a day, with no rest for many days in a row. Can't bear it anymore and want to take leave? You must produce various certificates, and you may even be threatened with "credits" by the school. Once the body is really tired and something goes wrong: The school says: "People are interning in a company, and the company should be responsible." The company says: "The students are sent by the school, and we just use them." The two sides play ball with each other, and in the end, the only one who is left in the middle, bleeding, sweating and crying, is the student who has no choice. Looking at the entire chain, schools use graduation certificates to lock people in, intermediaries are responsible for batch transportation, and factories receive cheap labor. items.core: A middle-aged woman doing business met a man through the Internet.
body: Explanation: There is such a case of online dating fraud circulating on the Internet: A middle-aged woman doing business met a man through the Internet. The two of them chatted from strangers online to "good friends", which lasted for more than half a year. Care every day. Chat every day. Talk about family. Talk about the future. At the end of the conversation, the other party even started planning: But the real ending was that millions of dollars were transferred out one by one. 1. In 7 months, money is not defrauded all at once. The really great thing about this kind of scam is that you are never in a hurry to eat it in one bite. Instead, slowly increase the amount. For example: tens of thousands of yuan for the first time. Later it was hundreds of thousands. Then to hundreds of thousands. Even a single transaction worth millions of dollars. The victim will not feel that he was suddenly defrauded of 7 million. What she faces every time may just be: When the seven months are over, she will look back and calculate: the total has reached millions of yuan. 2. After the money is gone, the scammer may even start "truthful confessions." The hardest thing for some victims to accept afterwards is not necessarily the amount. It’s the liar’s final attitude. In similar cases reported online, the scammer would even say something like this after confirming that the victim had no more cash. Sounds ridiculous. But for people who have been deceived for more than half a year, these words are very damaging. Because she suddenly realized: All the care, love, and commitment of the past few months had been work from day one. 3. Why do many victims say: "I accept the money, but I can't accept it emotionally"? Because money lost is a number. Emotional fraud destroys the entire memory. Good mornings are truly received every day. Late night chats were real. The concern when you are sick is truly visible. Arguments, reconciliations, future plans, all really happen on the phone. The only thing false is: the identity and purpose of the other party. Therefore, some victims with good financial conditions will repeatedly struggle after the case occurs: But for professional fraud teams, chatting itself is a business process. 4. The most important job of a scammer is to first determine how much money you have 📱 Mature online dating scammers will not come up and ask: Instead, they will slowly find out through chatting. For example: What business to do. Is there any room? Is there a loan? What car to drive. What do you usually invest in? Family members. Company size. How's the cash flow? Once it is judged that the target has strong financial strength, the backend will adjust the strategy. Ordinary targets may be defrauded of tens of thousands. High-net-worth targets may continue to operate for several months or even longer. 5. “I just transfer small amounts of money over and over again.” Why did it eventually turn into 7 million? Because fraud gangs are particularly good at exploiting sunk costs. After transferring 300,000 yuan: In order to get back 300,000 yuan, transfer another 200,000 yuan. After you have invested 1 million: The platform tells you to make additional deposits. Then to 2 million: taxes and fees appear again. Then there is the unfreezing fee. Upgrade fee. Large amount withdrawal certification. I tell you every time: What is really trapped in the end is not just the feelings, but also the money that has been invested before. 6. After the money is defrauded, is there any chance to recover it? Two extreme statements are most likely to appear here: One is: The other is: In fact, neither of them is accurate. The current rules are clear: The legal property of the victim whose ownership can be ascertained must be returned in a timely manner. If the funds in the involved account are not enough to be returned in full, they will be returned in proportion. In reality, it is true that public security organs have always issued announcements on the return of frozen funds involved in fraud, and returned to victims in proportion to the law. 7. The real difficulty is: after the money goes out, it will "disperse" quickly. The fraud gang usually does not keep 7 million in the same account after collecting the money. Instead, quickly pass by: bank card. Third party payment. Benchmark account. Merchant. Virtual assets…

body: Explanation: Can you believe that well-known domestic securities companies and financial software such as GF, CITIC, Flush, and Oriental Fortune have become the "culprits" for many people being defrauded of all their property? In fact, the vast majority of victims downloaded not official software at all, but "highly imitated and fake APPs" carefully created by black production teams! According to statistics, one leading brokerage firm alone received nearly 2,000 fake clues in one year, and hundreds of people went to the headquarters to ask for an explanation! How did the scammer set up this dragnet? 😱 The core reason why this kind of fraud can be successful repeatedly is to take advantage of people's trust in "big brands", coupled with an extremely mature chain of drainage and brainwashing: at the beginning, they will give you a small withdrawal sweetener. After you deposit hundreds of thousands or even millions of principal, the funds will be completely taken away on the grounds of "unfreeze fees, margins, illegal operations"!
Chapter: 💥 The trap of imitation APP: How do scammers trap you step by step? 🚨 Anti-fraud warning: Recognize the four iron rules and stay away from fake financial APPs

Routine: 1️⃣ Short video matrix drainage: A large number of "financial bloggers" appear on Douyin, Xiaohongshu and other platforms, using homogeneous popular copywriting to guide the country and attract followers. 📈 2️⃣ Draining traffic to private domain niche software: Using "WeChat ID/confidentiality needs" as an excuse, fans are lured to niche encrypted communication software to attract groups and build trust. 📱 3️⃣ Falsified myths and AI fake videos: The group publishes fake earnings screenshots every day, organizes "famous teacher lectures", and even uses AI face-changing technology to fake expert video certifications to deceive victims. 🤖 4️⃣ Inducing to download high imitation APP: Send a link to induce the victim to download the "Organization Promotion Exclusive APP". These softwares are exactly the same as regular software from their logos, colors to column layouts, but the background data (positions, profits, and turnover) are all controlled by scammers! 💰

Pitfalls: ❌ Never click on unknown download links: Regular brokerage software must be downloaded through the official mobile app store or the official website of the brokerage (look for the official domain name). Never click on the link or QR code sent by WeChat/Telegram/webpage to install! 📲 ❌ Any request for private domain transactions must be a scam: All formal securities transactions are deposited through third-party banks. Anyone who requests to transfer funds to a personal account or "deposit" a public account of an unknown company is 100% a scammer! 🏧 ❌ Don’t believe in “internal promotion/guaranteed profit”: There is no guaranteed profit or loss-free business in the capital market. The more hype they say and the guarantee of high returns, the more ulterior motives they have! 📉 ❌ Be wary of niche communication software diverting traffic: Anyone who asks you to leave a big platform and go to a niche social software to "avoid supervision and discuss investment" will be blocked directly! 🚫
Download the brokerage APP only through the official application store or the official website of the securities company, and do not click on the download link sent by SMS or WeChat group.

To verify the authenticity of the APP, you can call the official customer service number of the securities company to check the website domain name and customer service qualifications. Do not believe the "low threshold, high returns" propaganda.
Stop the transfer immediately if you encounter "A deposit must be paid to withdraw cash", keep the evidence and call 110 or the anti-fraud hotline 96110 to report it.

Case: Shareholder Lao Zhang received a text message link, downloaded the "GF Securities" APP and invested 800,000 yuan. The initial platform showed profit. When withdrawing cash, the customer service said that a "deposit" was required. After Lao Zhang transferred the money, he found that the APP could not be logged in, and he found out that it was a high-quality imitation software of a fake brokerage.

body: Chapter: "I went to change the engine oil, but when I checked out, the bill was 4,600 yuan more!" 🚗😱 🪤 A trilogy of bad car repair routines: trapping people to death step by step

Explanation: The car repairman frowned and said, "Your brake pads are broken and the gearbox oil needs to be changed! If you don't repair it, the car won't be able to brake on the highway next time. What are the consequences?" Many car owners panicked upon hearing this and swiped their cards to pay without saying a word. However, if you show the replaced old parts to knowledgeable friends: the brake pads can still run for 20,000 kilometers, the transmission oil does not need to be changed at all, and some spare parts are not replaced at all! Today we will thoroughly reveal the three tricks used by some unscrupulous car repair shops to "routine car owners"! It's time for your car to be serviced. I found a shop online. The reviews were all positive and the price was half cheaper than the 4S shop. When I called him, the other party was extremely enthusiastic and said, "The masters are all from 4S stores and can get it done in half an hour." When you arrive at the scene and are about to check out and leave after completing the minor maintenance, the master starts to think about it. The master held the dismantled parts in his hand, frowned and said, "You have too much carbon deposits! The brake pads on the chassis are almost worn out, and something big will happen if you don't replace them!" Seeing your hesitation, he directly took out his mobile phone to show the photos of the accident car: "This is the accident where the brakes failed on the highway, and there were children in the car at the time..." Your heart skipped a beat, and your defense collapsed instantly. In order to make you feel that the price is transparent, the master makes a hands-free call to the "parts dealer" in front of you to inquire about the price. When you ask for a price on the other end of the phone, he turns around and tells you the original price, and thoughtfully adds: "Brother, I really don't make any money from you at this price, just treat it as a friend!" You think you have met a real person, and you are willing to swipe your card to pay. There are even some unscrupulous merchants who don’t even bother to replace your old ones. They will take your old ones out, wipe them, then turn around and put them back for you. It’s just a waste of money! Most of the good reviews of black shops come from brushes. The so-called "4S shops" may have been fired for issuing false bills! When going for car repair and maintenance, please be sure to remember the following two points: 🙅‍♂️ Stick to the principle: just do small maintenance! No matter how serious the master talks about other items, he always answers: "There is not enough time today, I will go to the regular store to check another day." 📦 Take away the old parts: All the old parts that have been replaced, the master is required to pack them all and put them in the trunk! If the other party resists and refuses to respond, there is a good chance that there is something wrong with you! Please forward this to remind car owners and friends around you, don’t become a “cash machine” for unscrupulous car repair shops just for the sake of cheapness! 🙅‍♂️✨ There are scammers everywhere online and there are endless scammers! items.title: Beware! How were your virtual coins quietly stolen? Revealing the most common "unsense coin stealing" illegal production routine
items.core: Do you know? The most popular and most common criminal method in the currency circle today is "senseless coin theft".
body: Explanation: Do you know? The most popular and most common criminal method in the currency circle today is "senseless coin theft". To put it simply, you don’t need too many complicated operations. You may just click a simple signature or authorization, and the scammer can transfer all the virtual assets in your wallet anytime and anywhere. There are no obvious warning reminders during the whole process. It is not until you open your wallet one day to check your balance that you find that it is already empty. Today we will completely expose this lowest-cost and most deceptive illegal theft technology! Under normal circumstances, if you want to operate the virtual currency in the wallet, you must click Approve once. This is exactly what the black industry is targeting: Unlimited authorization: Scammers will try their best to trick you into clicking on malicious smart contracts written by them. Ordinary authorization is for a single transaction, but once the illegal contract is authorized, it is "unlimited". Silent monitoring, fattening and then killing: After obtaining the permission, the scammer will not take action immediately, but secretly monitor the status of your wallet, and even continue to guide you to transfer more assets into the wallet. Until they think the amount is large enough to close the network, they will transfer it all at once. You have almost no awareness until you are emptied. Scammers usually put on various glamorous clothes to seduce you: 🎁 Authorized signature phishing: Scammers cast a wide net on social platforms, using excuses such as airdrop tokens, new currency pre-sales, free NFTs, mining machine rebates, platform dividends, exchange upgrade verification, etc. to induce you to click on phishing links. These pages will deliberately obscure the permission descriptions, and you have no idea how serious the consequences of clicking on authorization are. 👾 Silent hijacking by virus Trojans: Inducing you to download so-called "cracked wallets", "airdrop assistance tools", "quantitative trading software" or fake exchange apps. Once you follow the instructions to import the mnemonic phrase or private key, the virus will quietly read it in the background and upload it to the scammer's server, waiting to close the network at any time. 📈 Financial management rebate scam: guide you to bind your wallet and sign the "automatic deduction agreement". This kind of routine is extremely hidden. Black businesses will set up small, high-frequency deductions specifically to avoid large-amount risk control reminders, and slowly eat away at your assets like drawing blood. Scammers have endless tricks, but the underlying logic of prevention is actually very simple: 🧹 Clean authorizations regularly: Develop the habit of regularly using security tools (such as Revoke, etc.) to check and clean up unknown and long-term unused authorizations. 📱 Don’t touch software from unknown sources: The wallets you download blindly and the exchanges you visit are most likely to be fake apps that are copied 1:1 by scammers. It’s already 2026, and the opportunity to get rich overnight through virtual currency is long gone. For a pure novice, it is not easy to be deceived when entering this unregulated field. Make money safely and never touch these various virtual currencies. This is the best way to prevent being cheated! If you want to keep your wallet tight, you must always be vigilant about "pie in the sky".

Set transaction limits for wallets, enable double verification, and regularly change authorized wallet addresses

Today we will thoroughly explain this: Which are your legitimate rights and interests, and which are traps designed to defraud hard-earned money? If you really encounter a debt crisis, what is the correct way to save yourself? Many people tend to confuse these concepts, and end up being led by illegal sources: 📊 Formal debt planning (neutral): Help you sort out your debt structure. For example, integrating multiple scattered online loans, applying to institutions to extend the repayment cycle, and replacing them with lower-cost repayment plans, the purpose is to reduce the monthly payment pressure. This is normal financial adjustment behavior. Real formal services can only help you reduce the amount of money you need, so you can't make quick money; while the black industry team relies on boasting to make you desperate "medical money"! The process of this scam has been highly standardized, stepping on your anxiety and fear at every step: behind banks and licensed financial institutions are professional legal and actuarial teams, and interest rate charges are basically stuck within the compliance framework. It is simply unrealistic from the underlying logic to rely on a black property intermediary to ask the bank to waive the principal and refund the interest in full with just a few words. 👉 What is truly refundable: Only interest that exceeds the scope of legal protection and miscellaneous fees collected in violation of regulations. Today's formal platforms rarely step on this red line, and very few can retreat. As for the non-compliant niche pheasant online loans, they themselves are black accounts, and they are even less likely to refund their money obediently. 👉 Real negotiation channel: If you do temporarily lose the ability to repay due to force majeure such as unemployment, major illness, etc., you can directly call the official customer service number and submit true supporting materials, and you can apply for interest exemption, interest suspension or installment! The process is completely open and transparent. Almost all formal institutions will not reduce or reduce the principal at will, and there is no need to spend money to find a so-called intermediary to handle it. When facing debt, don't be superstitious about any "internal channels". Please follow the following steps to handle it pragmatically: 📝 Sort out the debt bill: Calculate each principal, interest rate and repayment rules. For debts that are within the scope of legal compliance, repayment must be proactively planned. 📞 Directly contact the official: If you encounter difficulties, directly call the official customer service number of the bank or platform. Frankly explain your situation and apply for negotiated repayment, penalty interest reduction, or extended account period. Official customer service is the most formal and secure communication channel. 🔒 Stick to the bottom line of privacy: Keep your identity and account information tight. Do not hand over your ID card, bank card, or verification code to any unknown intermediary to avoid irreversible secondary losses. Everyone wants to get rid of the anxiety and helplessness after going into debt as soon as possible. But the more difficult the time, the more important it is to keep calm and never seek medical treatment in a hurry. Debts will not disappear in a vacuum. Most of those who claim to be able to help you write off your debt or make a substantial reduction are just scammers who are eyeing the last bit of money in your pocket. You are already in a difficult situation, and being defrauded of another service fee will only make it worse. Face it squarely, plan your income, negotiate through formal channels, and pay it back slowly step by step. Although the road is slow, walk steadily and you will not step into a new abyss!

items.core: Auntie suddenly stops you in the mall, holding a video phone on the phone, and asks you to help her read the blurred bank card number to the camera..."
body: Explanation: "Auntie suddenly stops you in the mall, holding a video phone on the phone, and asks you to help her read the blurred bank card number into the camera..." This is definitely not an ordinary neighborly mutual aid, but a new type of AI loan fraud trap that is spreading wildly on the streets and taking advantage of the goodwill of passers-by! As long as you show compassion, you will accidentally shoulder a huge amount of online loan debt for the scammer. Today we directly break down the inside story of this new street scam. When looking for targets on the streets, scammers know how to tap into people's sympathy for their elders and the weak: 📍 Targeting bustling neighborhoods/shopping malls: They usually choose to commit crimes in crowded shopping malls or streets, pretending to be old people who are not good at using smartphones. 📱 Video calls on the line: The aunt suddenly stops you, holding a mobile phone during a video call. 🗣️ Words to lower your guard: She will act very anxious, claiming that her bank card number is too blurry to see the numbers clearly, and she wants you to "help" and read the card number to the person on the other end of the video. Behind this seemingly ordinary request for help on the street, the people connected to the other end of the video are not the family members of the elderly at all, but a sophisticated black industry team and AI real-time capture equipment: 🎙️ Voice Verification Capture: When you face the camera without any precautions and clearly read out the digits of your bank card, Pankou's voiceprint collection system has recorded and extracted your voice characteristics in real time 📸 Facial feature lock: At the same time, the video call interface on the other side will capture your face movements, blinking, mouth opening and other biometric information in high definition. The most vicious part of this trick is that it does not require any code scanning, no transfer, and does not even require you to provide any information about yourself. items.title: Signing orders at low prices but getting more and more expensive? Revealing the harvesting routine of "malicious additions" to whole-house customization
items.core: When decorating a house to make customized furniture, many people will compare the quotes from several companies and finally choose the one with the lowest price to sign the order, thinking that they have saved a lot of money. But when production actually started and installation came on site, we discovered that the original low quotation was just a bait!
body: Explanation: When decorating a house and making customized furniture, many people will compare the quotes from several companies and finally choose the one with the lowest price to sign the order, thinking that they have saved a lot of money. But when production actually started and installation came on site, we discovered that the original low quotation was just a bait! Along the way, money was added to various additional items one after another, and work was stopped if no money was added. In the end, the total price exceeded the budget by a large margin, which made it difficult to get off the mark! 🤦‍♂️ This type of merchant has no intention of doing low-price business from the beginning, and relies on adding items midway to gain huge profits: If you want to avoid being slaughtered by merchants as "fat sheep", you must master the following core points: Don't let the cheap price cover up the huge trap behind it, refuse vague quotes, protect your wallet and decorate in a good mood! 🛡️
Chapter: 💥 Dismantling of the low-price traffic trap: How did he "trap" you step by step? 🚨 Guide to avoid pitfalls: How to prevent "malicious additions" to customized furniture?

Routine: 1️⃣ Not reporting all the missing parts (deliberately concealing accessories): When making a sales quotation, only the basic cabinet price is deliberately quoted, and all necessary accessories are excluded, such as cabinet doors, hardware, handles, drawers, installation fees, transportation fees and even measurement fees! Nothing is mentioned when quoting, and you only start asking for money item by item after you pay the deposit and sign the contract. 💸 2️⃣ Threatening to “stop work”: Want to add a drawer? Add money! Want to use better hardware? Add money! Delivery and installation? Charged separately! Even if the merchant makes an error in his or her own size measurement, he or she will find a reason to ask you to pay more for corrections. Don't you agree? Stop work directly and delay the construction period until you compromise! Owners who can't afford to delay can only raise prices tearfully again and again. ⏰ 3️⃣ Shifting the blame, there is no way to protect your rights: Even if you add money, the final product is the wrong size and the workmanship is rough, the merchant will find various excuses to refuse to make corrections. The contract is full of vague terms and word games, making it difficult for the owner to find strong evidence! 📝

Pitfalls: ❌ Look at the details without looking at the total price: Do not only compare the total quotation, you must check the quotation item by item! Ask clearly whether all potential expenses such as cabinet doors, hardware, handles, number of drawers, delivery fees to the floor, installation fees, re-testing fees, etc. are included. 🔍 ❌ Implement all commitments into the contract: Write the selected hardware brand, number of drawers, installation and transportation standards into the contract in black and white, and eliminate "verbal promises on site". 📝 ❌ Rules for locking in additional items and liability for breach of contract: It is clearly agreed in the contract that "changes and additions without the owner's signature and confirmation will not be paid", and it is noted that the cost of order changes caused by the merchant's measurement errors shall be borne by the merchant himself! ⚖️

Before signing the contract, the merchant is required to list the cost details of all possible additional items, indicate "No increase in price without reasonable reasons" and write in the supplementary terms of the contract.
Go to the factory to inspect the production process and confirm whether the main material models such as plates and hardware are consistent with the quotation to avoid shoddy products.

On-site verification will be carried out throughout the installation process. If additional items are found, construction will be suspended immediately, and chat records and call recordings will be retained as evidence for rights protection.

Case: The owner, Mr. Liu, chose the lowest-priced whole-house customization. After signing the contract, he was told that the cabinet depth, drawers, hardware, edge sealing and door-to-door installation would all be charged extra. The original plan of 38,000 yuan increased to 62,000 yuan, and the work would be stopped without adding any money.

Do you feel that you have picked up a huge leak for the first time? Today, I will reveal to you the money-making routine behind the second-hand platform "Excellent Pick-up"! If you look closely, you will find that the copywriting of this type of "low-price headphones" is completely different from that of serious merchants: They never write "bulk supply" or "new stock"; instead, they deliberately create a persona for ordinary people to resell idle items: "Given by an ex-boyfriend", "moving out of stock", "unused"; the pictures are all high-definition pictures that are life-like and casually taken. Why package them like this? The biggest obstacle to second-hand transactions is never the authenticity of the product, but trust. When facing a professional merchant, you will instinctively be defensive; but when facing an ordinary person who claims to "handle personal belongings", everyone will unconsciously put down their guard. When you take the initiative to send a private message to verify the authenticity, the other party is not in a hurry to urge you to place an order, but very calmly shows you the serial number and detailed pictures of the actual product, and repeatedly promises to "support various verification methods". Many people are fooled here! What you verify is only a string of public serial number information, not the actual device sent to you by express delivery! The black production gang predicts all the concerns of the buyer in advance: Worried about fakes? 👉 Show you the traceability information and serial number; Worried about the quality of the product? 👉 Send pictures of various details; Afraid of being cheated? 👉 Promise to support face-to-face inspection. In the end, it’s not the seller who convinces you, but you keep convincing yourself: “It’s so cheap, it’s a shame to miss it! "After the express delivery, the appearance of the headphones was extremely lifelike, the basic functions were normal, and the pop-up window displays were all available. Many people immediately clicked "Confirm receipt". There is a deep human psychology hidden here: 680 yuan to get a product with an original price of 1,800 yuan, no one wants to believe that they have cheated. Do you think they just make a profit by selling one or two pairs of fake headphones? This is only the first level! The real money-making model is: Upstream suppliers: Continuous supply of high imitation accessories; Midstream trader: a set of fixed words + a batch of fake materials + batch matrix account activation; downstream risk avoidance: once the account is blocked by risk control, immediately change to a new account and continue the cycle. The core of this routine is not "selling goods" at all, the headphones are just the carrier. What they reap is poor information, poor trust and poor humanity. All risks ultimately fall on the buyer. 🤝 The seller is overly enthusiastic and proactively and perfectly eliminates all your concerns 🚨. Remember: A truly clever scam will not make you wary, it will just keep hinting to you that "good luck has come, it's finally your turn to take advantage"!

items.title: Can a "flight cancellation" call tell you your seat number? Flight ticket refund and change scam emptied two cards in ten minutes
items.core: The day before departure, I suddenly received an overseas call starting with 00. The other party calls himself "airline customer service", accurately reports your name, ID number, flight number, and departure time, and then tells you with an apologetic look: the flight was canceled due to mechanical failure, and the company will take the initiative to change your flight and pay you 300 yuan for delay insurance.
body: Explanation: The day before departure, I suddenly received an overseas call starting with 00. The other party calls himself "airline customer service", accurately reports your name, ID number, flight number, and departure time, and then tells you with an apologetic look: the flight was canceled due to mechanical failure, and the company will take the initiative to change your flight and pay you 300 yuan for delay insurance. The information is all accurate and the tone is professional and considerate. Would you believe it? Countless travelers across the country have already submitted the letter - and within ten minutes, the money in their cards was emptied, and all the online loan limits that they didn't even know about were taken out and withdrawn. The scammer first buys your booking information from the black market (there are cases of leaks by airline insiders and ticketing companies), and then recites your name, flight number, and seat information verbatim when you call, instantly breaking your guard. The flight was canceled due to "mechanical failure" or "bad weather", and we offered to change the flight and pay compensation. Pay attention to this detail: the scammer will even ask you to perform a refund on a regular platform first, creating the illusion of "refund failure" and making you feel that you really need "manual assistance." "The claim settlement procedure is complicated, I will assist you remotely" - a link is sent to induce you to download a video conferencing app such as "Collaboration Assistant", open a fake Civil Aviation Administration page, and enable screen sharing. From this moment on, every character entered on your phone and every verification code that pops up will be visible to the scammer in real time. They will ask you to submit SMS verification codes one by one on the grounds of "confirming your identity" and "verifying the payment channel"; after the money in the card is empty, they will also induce you to borrow money from various online loan platforms on the grounds that "the claim settlement channel needs to verify your repayment ability" until all available loan limits are exhausted.

Routine: 1️⃣ Start with accurate information and pretend to be official customer service 2️⃣ Take the initiative to settle claims to give you a sweetener 3️⃣ Guide you to download the software and enable screen sharing 4️⃣ Use a series of verification codes to drain your savings and then take out online loans

Pitfalls: ❌ "Failure to claim compensation will affect your credit report", "The claim settlement channel is closed today" - creating panic and a sense of urgency are the standard words of all cancellation and rebooking scams.
Warning: ⚠️ Calling "customer service" one or two days before departure is the most dangerous. This is taking advantage of your eagerness to travel and fear of things going wrong.

Defense: 🛡️ Remember an iron rule: real customer service will never let you download software, enable screen sharing, ask for verification codes, or ask for bank card passwords. Refunds will only be returned to the payment account via the original route, "refund where you purchased it from." 🛡️ If you receive "flight cancellation" or "delay claim" information, do not call back the caller number. Please verify through the airline's official customer service, official app or ticket purchase platform; if you have any questions, call the anti-fraud hotline 96110.

Law: ⚖️ Pretending to be an airline customer service person to defraud money in the name of canceling, changing or rebooking claims constitutes the crime of fraud in Article 266 of the Criminal Law. Defrauding more than 3,000 yuan meets the prosecution standard for "large amounts"; airlines and ticketing "insiders" who resell passenger information also constitute the crime of infringing on citizens' personal information and are subject to severe penalties.

Xingnao: 🛑 If screen sharing is turned on and the phone loses control, immediately shut it down or unplug the phone card to stop the loss; if you find you have been deceived, call 110 as soon as possible. The police can urgently stop the payment on the account involved - a traveler who was defrauded of 430,000 yuan was almost fully recovered after calling the police.

Case: Mr. Wang received a call from overseas, and the other party accurately reported his flight information saying "cancelled due to mechanical failure" and guided him to click on a link to fill in his bank card and receive a 300 yuan claim. After the operation, he received a debit text message, and a total of 46,000 yuan was transferred from the two cards.

The other party can accurately report your express delivery number, name, and delivery address. You thought that the express delivery had not arrived anyway, so you followed the instructions - and then the money in the card was gone. Scammers specifically target users with delayed logistics and stranded packages. They call at the right time for "urgent shipments" and the information is so accurate that you can't help but believe it. "I can't explain it clearly on the phone. Please add me on WeChat and I will teach you how to operate it step by step." After adding a friend, the other party sent a QR code or link saying it was a "claims settlement channel." Scan the code to enter an "Express Official Website" that is almost exactly the same as the official one. The page requires you to fill in: name, ID number, bank card number, password, card balance, and finally an SMS verification code. When you fill in the verification code for the first time, the page prompts "Incorrect input, please re-enter" - this is not because you entered it wrong, but because the scammer is using this excuse to make you enter more times so that you can complete multiple deductions. By the time you receive one deduction text message after another, the other party has already blacklisted you and left.

Routines: 1️⃣ Keep an eye on people with abnormal logistics 2️⃣ Take the initiative to pay compensation and add friends 3️⃣ Fill in the information on a fake official website 4️⃣ Enter the verification code "incorrectly", resulting in repeated fraud

Pitfalls: ❌ "If you don't claim compensation, it will automatically be invalidated" and "Expiration will be considered as giving up" - all the claims that urge you to hurry up are preventing you from thinking about it.

Warning: ⚠️ There is a variant of the same script: I received a text message that "the express delivery failed and has been withdrawn." When I called back, the other party said that your express delivery has a "million protection" policy, and if you don't cancel today, you will be deducted 20,000 per month.

Prevention method: 🛡️ If the express delivery is lost, please verify it through the shopping platform or the official app of the express company or the official customer service phone number. Do not click on any unfamiliar text messages or any links sent by the "claims specialist". 🛡️ The verification code is the last lock. Do not fill it in on the webpage provided by others or report it to any "customer service" under any circumstances.

Law: ⚖️ Forging the official express website to steal bank card information constitutes the crime of theft or fraud; those who create and maintain phishing websites are also guilty of assisting information network criminal activities.

Xingnao: 🛑 Remember it word for word: If the express company really wants to pay compensation, the money will be directly returned to your payment account through the original route. You do not need to provide passwords and verification codes throughout the process.

Case: Ms. Zhang received a call from "Express Delivery Claims", and the other party claimed that the lost package would require triple compensation. She followed the instructions to fill in her bank card number and password on the shared screen, and then received a transfer reminder, and the 23,000 yuan in the card disappeared.
items.remember: Whether the express delivery is lost, please verify through the shopping platform or the official app of the express company or the official customer service phone number. Do not click on any unfamiliar text messages or any links sent by the "claims specialist".

items.title: "Crab cards" and "delivery coupons" in unknown express delivery are new vests for order fraud
items.core: Recently, many people have received inexplicable express delivery: an exquisite hairy crab gift card, a "0 yuan pickup card", a scratch-off ticket, or a mobile phone holder, a small fan, and a gel pen. You don’t know the sender, but there is a QR code printed on the card: scan the code to pick up the goods and claim the prize.
body: Explanation: Recently, many people have received inexplicable express delivery: an exquisite hairy crab gift card, a "0 yuan pick-up card", a scratch-off ticket, or a mobile phone holder, a small fan, and a gel pen. You don’t know the sender, but there is a QR code printed on the card: scan the code to pick up the goods and claim the prize. Who doesn’t want free crabs? Scan the code and you will join the group. Scammers buy recipient information through illegal channels and send low-cost small gifts across a wide network. Once you receive the real thing, your vigilance will be halved: "You can't be a scammer, right? The scammer is charging you for the express delivery?" After scanning the code, you enter the chat interface. The "customer service" checks the information on the card with a professional attitude, and then sends you a second QR code to join the "welfare group". There are hundreds of people in the group, and some people post screenshots of "successfully receiving gifts" every day. The group announcement said: If you follow the public account and like the video, you can get a commission. You will be given a few or dozens of dollars back first, and real money will arrive in your account. You think this money is really easy to come by. Next is the "advanced task": download the designated app, advance funds to complete the task, and promise to "swipe 100,000 and get 15% back". It gives you a taste of the sweetness when the amount is small, but when you invest your savings, there will be an "account abnormality" and "fund freeze" in the App, and the customer service will ask you to continue to invest more to unfreeze it - until you empty out your savings or even start borrowing money.
Routines: 1️⃣ Cold express delivery 2️⃣ Scan the QR code to join the group, customer service reception 3️⃣ Small task rebates 4️⃣ Large advance payment, harvest
Pitfalls: ❌ All the screenshots of posting orders are trustworthy, and all group friends who have "received" are part of the script.

Warning: ⚠️ The official version of this routine is even more bluffing: after receiving a courier with a red-headed document bearing the "Rural Revitalization Implementation Plan," scan the QR code to enter the group to receive the "National Poverty Alleviation Fund," and first pay a 2% activation fee, then personal income tax, and then "the bank card number is filled in incorrectly and you need to pay an unfreeze fee" - someone was defrauded of nearly 200,000 yuan.

Defense: 🛡️ Do not scan the QR code when receiving an unknown express delivery; crabs will not fall from the sky, only traps will fall. 🛡️ Brushing orders is illegal in itself, and all rebates for deposits and brushing orders are scams. Do not participate.
Law: ⚖️ Organizing a fraud scam constitutes the crime of fraud; if participants help the scammers to transfer funds, they may also be charged with the crime of trust.
Xingnao: 🛑 Remember this sentence: The "task" that asks you to pay small money first, and then big money, every step is a slaughtering process tailor-made for you.

Case: Aunt Li received a strange express delivery, which contained a "0 yuan pick-up crab card". After scanning the code, she was pulled into the group for "like and rebate". The first two orders received a cashback of 80 yuan, but the customer service for the third order asked her to transfer 20,000 yuan on the grounds of "consecutive orders", and then lost contact.
items.remember: Faking orders is illegal in itself, and all rebates on advance deposits and counterfeiting are scams. Do not participate.

items.title: "Medical insurance card deactivated" "ETC locked"? "Official" text messages with links are all phishing
items.core: The text message was signed "official" and the content was returned to the deadline. If you believe it and click on it, you will enter a fake website of "Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security" or "ETC Express Card Customer Service Center" - the page is solemn and formal, with many forms: license plate number, name, ID number, mobile phone number, bank card number, bank card password, card number, etc.
body: Chapter: "[Medical Security Bureau] Your medical card has been suspended. Please open the link to complete the information before February 27." "[123 Traffic Management Office] Your ETC has been suspended on February 28. For your normal driving, please click the link to authorize."

Note: The signature of the text message is "official" and the content is returned to the deadline. If you believe it and click on it, you will enter a website that imitates the "Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security" or "ETC Express Card Customer Service Center" - the page is solemn and formal, with many forms: license plate number, name, ID number, mobile phone number, bank card number, bank card password, and card balance. Fraudulent text messages are often sent from overseas numbers starting with 00 or using number-changing software. The signatures are casually written as "Medical Insurance Bureau", "Traffic Management Office" and "Taxation Bureau". You can't verify it on the spot anyway. "Deadline processing", "overdue account cancellation", "cancellation of reimbursement qualifications" - if you don't do it right away, you will suffer a loss. This will force you to have no time to think. The fishing page is made exactly the same as the official website, even the icon and color number are copied. The more detailed information you have to fill in, the easier it will be for scammers to steal money from your card. The last step is always to ask for an SMS verification code. Some pages will deliberately prompt "Incorrect verification code, please re-enter", asking you to enter the verification code a few more times - if you enter the verification code more times, the scammer will make more mistakes.
Routines: 1️⃣ Pseudo base stations send mass messages, sign and pretend to be official 2️⃣ Create a sense of urgency 3️⃣ High imitation websites collect information 4️⃣ Harvest verification codes
Pitfalls: ❌ "Abnormal medical insurance card", "ETC invalid", "Social security account will be frozen" - the words are often changed, but the link in the text message remains unchanged.

Warning: ⚠️ Official text messages will never ask you to fill in your bank card password and verification code. Medical insurance, social security, and ETC services can all be handled in the official App, official mini program, or offline window.

Prevention: 🛡️ Ask whoever you claim to be to verify who you are: call 12333 for medical insurance issues, and contact the issuer’s official customer service for ETC issues. Do not click on links in text messages. 🛡️ No one will give you the verification code - the verification code is the password and is the last line of defense for your account. 🛡️ If you receive such text messages, please call the 96110 anti-fraud hotline to report it and help the police quickly block the phishing website.

Law: ⚖️ Making and distributing phishing links to steal other people’s bank card information and use it for fraud constitutes the crime of fraud and theft; serious cases may be sentenced to more than ten years in prison.
Xingnao: 🛑 One sentence: Any "official notification" with a link in a text message asking you to fill in your bank card information will be treated as a fraud and will not be unfairly punished.

Case: Mr. Zhao received the "ETC locked" text message and clicked the link to fill in the license plate, ID card and bank card information. The next day, he discovered that 18,000 yuan had been spent on his card in another place. The bank reminded him that the domain name in the text message was a counterfeit ".com.cn" fake website.
items.remember:
Verify whoever you claim to be: for medical insurance issues, call 12333, for ETC issues, contact the issuer’s official customer service, and do not click on links in text messages.
In a word: Any "official notification" that contains a link in a text message and asks you to fill in your bank card information will be treated as a fraud and will not be unjust.

items.title: "Internal channels" to "snatch" concert tickets? Fans’ money went into other people’s casinos
items.core: Tickets will be empty within seconds of opening. You spent several rounds of official ticketing platforms but still couldn't get your idol's concert tickets, so you opened the comment sections of Xianyu, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin - "Tickets issued through internal channels", "Professional agents, if you can't get a full refund", "Add 300 to the ticket price, it's guaranteed."
body: Note: Tickets will be empty within seconds of opening. You spent several rounds of official ticketing platforms but still couldn't get your idol's concert tickets, so you opened the comment sections of Xianyu, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin - "Tickets issued through internal channels", "Professional agents, if you can't get a full refund", "Add 300 to the ticket price, it's guaranteed." You transferred money. Then, "Tickets are being issued" turned into "Wait a minute", and "Wait a minute" turned into a red exclamation mark. You've been blocked. Scammers publish a large number of ticket grabbing and transfer information on social platforms and second-hand platforms. They specifically target fans who have failed to grab tickets and are eager to get tickets. They take the initiative to strike up a conversation through private messages and speak enthusiastically: "Sister, I am also a fan. I understand you!" They send screenshots of successful ticket grabs and order details pages - all P's. Some even give you small rebates or real receipts first to build trust and lure you into making the next large transfer. After all the "robbing fees", "handling fees", "deposits" and "final payments" were collected, they were immediately blocked and lost contact as the show was about to start. The money you transfer with great expectation may be resold and invested in the casino. There are also people who claim to be "ticket managers" and "organizer insiders". They have even completed one or two tickets in exchange for trust, and then charged many fans a large amount of ticket money for their own use, and defrauded a total of six figures.
Routine: 1️⃣ Sneak into fans to fish 2️⃣ Forge evidence of "getting tickets" 3️⃣ Block people after receiving payment 4️⃣ High-end version of "fake scalpers"
Pitfalls: ❌ "Internal tickets", "Discount tickets", "Hoarding tickets", "Scalper prices are collected" - there is no guarantee for any transaction that bypasses the official ticketing platform.

Warning: ⚠️ Be wary of rhetoric such as "accounts are frozen and need to be transferred to unfreeze", "pay a deposit in advance", "pay a deposit", and requests for screen sharing to "check orders", these are all serial routines.

Defense: 🛡️ Only use the official website of the organizer and formal ticketing platforms to purchase tickets, and do not trust any "internal channels" on social software; before making a private transfer, ask yourself: Who is the other party? Where do the tickets come from? Who to call if there is a problem? 🛡️ Once you are defrauded, save the chat records and transfer vouchers as soon as possible and report to the police in time. Do not delete the records.

Law: ⚖️ Defrauding money in the name of grabbing tickets on behalf of others, larger amounts constitute a crime of fraud: someone defrauded 7,320 yuan and was sentenced to seven months, and someone faked the identity of a ticket manager and defrauded 93,000 yuan and was sentenced to three years - money for chasing stars is also money, and the law treats everyone equally.
Xingnao: 🛑 Remember: real tickets only come from official channels; all strangers who "I have channels", the channel leads to your wallet.

Case: Xiao Chen, a college student, went to Xianyu to find an "internal agent". After transferring 1,500 yuan, he received a forged e-ticket. Scanning the code on site showed that it was invalid, and the seller quickly canceled his account and disappeared.
items.remember:
Only use the official website of the organizer and formal ticketing platforms to purchase tickets, and do not trust any "internal channels" on social software; before making a private transfer, ask yourself: Who is the other party? Where do the tickets come from? Find problems

items.title: "WeChat million guarantee expires, monthly deduction is 2000"? This function is originally free
items.core: Hello, I am a staff member of the WeChat Payment Center. The 'Million Protection' service you subscribed expires today, and 2,000 yuan will be automatically deducted every month thereafter. Do I need to cancel it for you? "
body: Description: "Hello, I am a staff member of the WeChat Payment Center. The 'Million Protection' service you subscribed expires today, and 2,000 yuan will be automatically deducted every month thereafter. Do I need to cancel it for you? "Many people were anxious when they heard that money was going to be deducted: Cancel it for me! So, a FaceTime video call came in... The scammers pretended to be WeChat, Alipay, bank customer service, and even directly used FaceTime to make videos - the nickname can be changed to "WeChat Customer Service Center". WeChat officials have never used FaceTime to contact any user, and all this method is fake. "Million Guarantee" is actually a free security feature of WeChat Pay, and there is no expiration fee at all. Scammers are betting that you don't know. They ask you to join a QQ group and download a conference app with a screen sharing function. The "customer service" voice guides you step by step, but they actually watch your screen to steal information. Let you open the payment page of WeChat, Alipay, and mobile banking, state your bank card number, and then trick you into reading out the verification code you received - several transfer text messages will arrive immediately, and someone was defrauded of 43,000 yuan in one order

Routine: 1️⃣ Pretending to be a platform customer service call 2️⃣ Fictitious deductions to create panic 3️⃣ Pulling a group to "help with cancellation" 4️⃣ Open the payment page and steal money in real time

Pitfalls: ❌ "Cancel the business", "Failure to cancel will result in monthly deductions", "Affect your credit report" - first scare you, and then "help" you, this is the standard opening of customer service fraud
Warning: ⚠️ Similar phrases include "You have signed up for an e-commerce membership, and monthly deductions are 500" and "Account abnormalities require fund verification", all the same scripts

Prevention: 🛡️. WeChat's "Million Guarantee" is completely free and does not need to be cancelled; any calls claiming to be deducted or asking to be turned off for you are scams. 🛡️ Do not answer FaceTime video calls from strangers; users who do not use this feature, please turn off FaceTime calls directly in the "Settings" of the phone. 🛡️ Bank card numbers, passwords, and verification codes are not provided to any "customer service"; once the verification code is spoken, it is equivalent to handing the card to the scammer.

Law: ⚖️ Impersonating customer service to commit fraud constitutes a crime of fraud; if the organizer, call team, and traffic management team have clear divisions of labor, they will be severely punished as a joint crime of fraud
Xingnao: 🛑 Please keep one judgment criterion in mind: any platform that actively calls you to refund your money, shut down your business, or cancel deductions is a scam for you.

Case: Ms. Zhang, a citizen, received a FaceTime call. The other party claimed to be WeChat customer service and said that the one-million-dollar guarantee had expired and 2,000 yuan would be deducted every month. Ms. Zhang believed it to be true and followed the instructions to transfer 20,000 yuan and "cancel the service." It was not until the real WeChat official customer service called to remind her that she discovered that she had been deceived and called the police.
items.remember: Please keep one judgment criterion in mind: any platform that actively calls you to refund your money, shut down your business, or cancel deductions is a scam for you.

Law: ⚖️ The production and sale of fake official documents and fake official seals to induce recharge is suspected of fraud and the crime of forging official documents and seals of state agencies; riders and trolls who organize refund fraud groups also constitute a joint crime.
Xingnao: 🛑 Please remember: scammers understand your psychological gap best - if you have lost money, it is easier to believe that "someone will pay you back".

After scanning the code to join the group, she was induced to download a strange app and invest more than 50,000 yuan to "recover the credit limit." " Recently, many people have seen this kind of "Digital RMB Entrepreneurship" advertisements in short videos and Moments, and some have even been tricked into pyramid schemes. Be careful, digital RMB is real, but these ways to "promote and make money" are all fake! 👇 Scammers claim to be "authorized promoters of the Digital RMB Operation Center" and trick you into downloading copycat apps, paying "agency franchise fees", and then recruiting people to get tiered dividends. This has nothing to do with digital RMB, it is essentially a pyramid scheme. "Grab digital RMB red envelopes for 1 yuan" and "Limited distribution of qualifications for internal testing". Digital RMB does not have any "private promotion rebates" and will not "add value" through investment, financial management, or fraud, nor does it support "buying people to get dividends." Digital RMB is digital cash, just like the paper money in your hand, it is impossible to "make money". Anyone who asks you to pay money to join, attract people, buy financial services, or click on unfamiliar links under the banner of "digital RMB" is a scam. Only use digital RMB apps downloaded from official channels of banks and regular app stores. The rest of the "internal channels" are all pitfalls.

items.title: The phone call said, "The 3,600 yuan child care subsidy has arrived, click the link to claim it"? Novice parents, don’t accept this, this is fishing

body: Explanation: I have just given birth to a baby and am in confinement. Suddenly I received a "child care subsidy application notice" on my mobile phone. They can accurately report the child's birth date and even the name of the hospital, making you think it is an official notification. Send a link to a high imitation government website in the text message, and the "customer service" will teach you step by step over the phone to fill in your bank card number, ID card, and mobile phone number, and then ask you to read out the verification code. Policies such as childcare subsidies and maternity allowances do exist in various places, but they are all actively declared through government service platforms, communities or units. items.title: "Low-price good house, the landlord is out of town, pay the deposit first and then give the key"? The trap of renting a house starts when you see the "fishing house"

The other party "is out of town and refuses to look at the house" and urges you to pay the deposit first; some rent for several months, and the real landlord comes to the house, only to find that the "second landlord" took the money and ran away.
body: Explanation: During the graduation season, when changing jobs, you need to rent a house, and you find a cheap and good house, but the other party "is out of town and refuses to look at the house" and urges you to pay the deposit first; some rent for several months, and the real landlord comes to the house, only to find that the "second landlord" ran away with the money. In 2026, police and procuratorate agencies in many places reported housing rental scams. The tricks are not new, but people fall into the trap every year. 👇 Stealing pictures of well-decorated houses from Internet celebrities, with the price listed 30% to 50% lower than the market price, falsely claiming that "I am abroad and on a business trip", refusing to view the house offline, and only sending recorded videos, urging you to "pay a deposit first to lock the house, and I will send you the key." Once the money is handed over, you are immediately blocked. The scammer takes over the house from the landlord at a higher than market price, pays monthly rent, and then sublets it to you at a low price, but requires you to pay the rent in half a year, a year, or even two years. After you pay the long-term rent, he will take your money and run away, and the real landlord will take over the house, and you will lose everything. He forged the property certificate and ID card, rented the same house to several people at the same time, and lost contact after collecting the deposit; only when the tenants bumped into him did he realize that the landlord was fake. Give priority to formal intermediaries and formal long-term rental platforms, and the contract clearly states the liability for breach of contract and the return of the deposit. Renting a house is a big expense, and "cheap and good house + urging you to pay first" is the biggest danger signal. Don't transfer large amounts of rent and deposits easily before you get the key and move in.

Chapter: 📌 [Shadow Exposure] Three scams of renting a house - Those who are obviously lower than the market price, refuse to show the house, and only demand the deposit; - Insist on verifying the landlord's identity and real estate certificate, meet him and see the certificate clearly before signing the contract; - Try to use the platform to guarantee the rent or pay it monthly, and be wary of "one-time payment for one year and get a discount";

Routine: 1️⃣ Fishing for listings: stealing pictures at low prices, tricking you into paying a deposit first 🎣 2️⃣ High income and low rent, long income and short payment, second landlord takes the payment 💸 3️⃣ One room, two rents, fake landlord 🔑

items.title: What if you are really cheated? Golden half-hour self-rescue process, don’t wait for a second
items.core: I hope you will never need this article. But please read it to the end - every second after you are defrauded, money is flowing in the scammer's account at high speed. The faster you call the police, the more hope you have for recovery.
body: Note: I hope you never need this article. But please read it to the end - every second after you are defrauded, money is flowing in the scammer's account at high speed. The faster you call the police, the more hope you have of recovery. Tell the police officer directly: "I was defrauded by the telecommunications network." Tell three things clearly: the amount of money defrauded, the type of fraud (pretending to be customer service? Brushing orders?), the other party's receiving account and the transfer time. The public security organ will immediately initiate an emergency stop payment procedure and freeze the account involved - the golden window for stop payment is 48 hours. The earlier the stop payment is made, the more money will be frozen. Simultaneously call the customer service of the bank where you opened your account and apply for a temporary loss report or payment stop on your bank card; if your password is leaked, change it immediately; if you are induced to open an online loan, contact the platform customer service immediately to explain the situation and keep records. Transfer records (bank, WeChat, Alipay screenshots), chat records, call records, the other party’s account number, fraudulent apps and URLs – save all screenshots and don’t delete any of them! Many people feel that chat records are embarrassing and secretly delete them, which will make it twice as difficult to handle the case later. Bring evidence to the nearest police station (if a person is defrauded in another place, local reporting is equally effective, and the national integrated anti-fraud mechanism is linked across regions). Cooperate to complete the interrogation transcript; after the police secure the electronic evidence, they will then follow the guidelines to handle the fraudulent apps and links on the mobile phone.
Routine: 1️⃣ Dial 110 or 96110 as soon as possible 2️⃣ Contact the bank immediately 3️⃣ Keep all evidence 4️⃣ Make transcripts at the nearest police station

Pitfalls: ❌ The biggest secondary trap: "Internet police", "hackers" and "loss recovery teams" pop up on the Internet, claiming that paying money can help you recover your defrauded funds - the desire to recoup your money after being defrauded is exactly the target of the next wave of scammers. Anyone who collects money to "recover losses" is 100% a secondary fraud.
Warning: ⚠️ Never fail to call the police because the amount is not large or you feel embarrassed: every report is a clue for the police to merge cases and crack down on the entire chain.

Defense: 🛡️ Please stop transferring any money to the other party immediately; the moment you notice something is wrong, stopping the loss is ten thousand times more important than recovering the capital. 🛡️ You also need to save yourself emotionally: it is not your fault that you were deceived, scammers are professional criminal gangs. Tell your family to call the psychological assistance hotline when necessary, and never bear it alone or do extreme behavior.

Law: ⚖️ Article 64 of the "Criminal Law": All property illegally obtained by criminals shall be recovered, and the legal property of the victim shall be returned promptly - there is no shame in calling the police, and calling the police is the only formal way to get the money back.
Xingnao: 🛑 Please memorize the three "first moments": call 110 as soon as possible, contact the bank as soon as possible to stop the payment, and save the evidence as soon as possible.

Case: Ms. Zhang lost 50,000 yuan by clicking on a fake loan link. After discovering that she was deceived, she immediately called 110 and provided the other party's account number as required. The police initiated an emergency payment stop and froze the scammer's account within half an hour, ultimately helping her recover all her losses.

items.title: Many people have not used any of the seven pieces of anti-fraud equipment issued to you by the state.
items.core: Anti-fraud is not just about "being more careful". The country actually equips everyone with equipment. These seven tools are all free. If you use three of them, you will be 80% scammed and your link will be cut off.
body: Explanation: Anti-fraud is not just about "being more careful". The country actually equips everyone with equipment. These seven tools are all free. If you use three of them, you will be 80% scammed and your link will be cut off. It’s not a promotional software, but an anti-fraud firewall in your phone: if you turn on the “Incoming Call Alert”, you will be automatically alerted when suspected fraud calls come in; the “App Self-Check” can scan your phone for Trojans; it can also query suspicious accounts, URLs, and payment accounts, and report fraud clues with one click. Be sure to download it from the official app store and turn on the alert with your real name. This is a call from the police. If you receive 96110, it means that you or a family member is experiencing a scam. Please be sure to answer it and listen patiently - it is here to save your money. If you have any questions, you can take the initiative to call 96110 for consultation. Early warning channel pushed by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. Receiving a 12381 text message indicates that you may be being targeted by scammers, so immediately stop all "transfer operations" at hand. Using your ID card, you can check how many phone cards are issued under your name across the country. There are extra cards in your name that you don’t know about? Someone may have used your card fraudulently, so deal with it quickly and don’t wait for the police to come to your door. Use the mobile phone number and the last six digits of the ID number to check how many Internet accounts are registered associated with this number, and promptly discover accounts registered under false names. Find out how many bank cards you have opened in various banks with one click - the extra cards may be used by "card farmers" to run points. If you are involved in the case, you will be the first to be frozen. The Ministry of Public Security's dissuasion phone number carries an official certification mark, and the incoming call screen will display "National Anti-Fraud Center Police" - if you see this mark, feel free to answer it.

Routines: 1️⃣ National Anti-Fraud Center App 2️⃣ 96110 Early Warning and Dissuasion Hotline 3️⃣ 12381 Fraud Warning SMS 4️⃣ Phone Card "One Card Check" 5️⃣ Internet Account "One Card Check 2.0" 6️⃣ Cloud QuickPass "One-Click Card Check" 7️⃣ Anti-Fraud Business Card

Pitfalls: ❌ Some people think that "installing an anti-fraud app will cause your privacy to be monitored" - on the contrary, it does not read the chat content and only provides fraud identification and warning. Not installing it will open the door.

Defense method: 🛡️ Install and set up your parents’ mobile phones, and then teach them to recognize 96110; this set of actions is worth a Spring Festival red envelope.
