items.title: Earn millions a year by doing free cleaning without registering a company? Dismantling the zero-cost resource integration model and legal red lines
items.core: A 20-year-old girl can make millions a year with "free cleaning" without registering a company, hiring anyone, or renting a store? The underlying logic is "leverage cooperation + zero-cost resource integration": the left hand borrows housekeeping services, the middle hand uses free services in exchange for 1,000 window advertising spaces, and the right hand orders are divided - but there are two untouchable legal red lines!
body: Explanation: "A 20-year-old girl doesn't register a company, hire workers, or rent a store. She just earns more than 1 million yuan a year with "free cleaning"?!" Does it sound like a fantasy? You don’t have to do the work yourself, and you don’t even have to buy brooms and rags. How does this work? In fact, the underlying logic of this model is extremely clever "strengthening cooperation + zero-cost resource integration." She doesn't do cleaning, she does business in "traffic" and "channels". Today, I will show you how to completely dismantle this commercial closed loop that turns residents' windows into "money printing machines"! What should I do if I want to do housekeeping but I have no funds, experience, or equipment? Then just go and “borrow” it! She went directly to the local housekeeping companies and individual owners whose business was stagnant and lacked orders, and negotiated with them: "I will help you expand your customer base for free. You don't have to bear additional manpower. We will split the profits 50/50 after the transaction is completed!" For housekeeping businesses, they are naturally very happy to cooperate if someone can help attract traffic for free, and they only pay when there is work to do, and there are no additional expenses. In this way, girls can instantly have the workers, a full set of professional equipment and service capabilities of the cooperative housekeeping company without spending a penny, and they only need to focus on acquiring customers on the front end. This is the core and most subtle part of the entire model - using low-cost benefits to replace offline advertising spaces in the community: she purchased affordable trash cans as a stepping stone, targeting 30 high-end residential communities and screening 1,000 homeowners. Rules: The owner pays a deposit of 300 yuan and enjoys free cleaning, range hood and air conditioning cleaning services 4 times a year. The deposit will be fully refunded after the service period! The only condition: Housekeeping service advertising stickers must be allowed on floor-to-ceiling windows. The owner settled the score: just by posting an advertisement, you can get several professional housekeeping services for free, and the deposit will be refunded, so why not? The floor-to-ceiling windows of these 1,000 owners have become 1,000 "free outdoor advertising spaces" distributed throughout the community! Residents in the community come in and out every day, and uniform housekeeping advertisements can be seen everywhere on the windows of every house. It is easy to have psychological illusions: "Why are so many people using this company? It must be very reliable!" Following this, there is an endless stream of inquiries, and we receive hundreds of calls for inquiries and orders every day. She only needs to assign these paid orders that come to her door to the cooperative housekeeping company, and the profits generated will be divided directly in half. I don’t do the cleaning myself in the whole process, I am only responsible for docking and distribution. I can get millions of profits in a year just by sharing! Advertising compliance red line: Most residential properties have clear prohibitions on posting commercial advertisements on residents’ windows, and they may even be torn down forcibly on the grounds of damaging the appearance of the residential complex. At the same time, this is outdoor advertising and must comply with relevant city management and advertising regulations. If you don’t check with the property management and urban management in advance, the more you post, the more fines and disputes you may cause. Red line for deposit performance: 300 yuan for each of 1,000 owners is a capital pool of 300,000 yuan. If after the expiration, the merchant's capital chain is broken, or the merchant "refuses to return the deposit" or "deducts the fee in a clever way" subjectively, this will directly constitute consumer fraud, and may even be suspected of illegally absorbing public deposits or committing fraud! Commitments related to the deposit must be fulfilled truthfully, and do not regard the deposit as costless funds that can be spent casually.
Chapter: 📌 [Model Dismantling] "Zero Cost" Three Steps for the White Wolf with Empty Gloves

Routine: 1️⃣ The first step: Leveraging cooperation, zero-cost "empty gloves" housekeeping resources 🤝 2️⃣ The second step: Free cleaning + deposit to lock in customers, and replace the "glass window advertising space" with services 🪟 3️⃣ The third step: Traffic conversion and monetization, use word of mouth to achieve crazy sharing 📈
Warning: ⚠️ Fatal red lines: two untouchable legal high-voltage lines!

Xingnao: 🛑 Xingnao summary: Understand the underlying logic and don’t blindly follow the trend. The girl did not participate in the cleaning process. What she was doing was: with her left hand, she contacted housekeeping merchants to borrow service supplies to achieve zero-cost startup; in the middle, she exchanged free services for residents' window advertisements to obtain precise offline traffic at a very low cost; with her right hand, she converted the traffic into actual orders and relied on cooperation sharing to obtain profits. If you want to imitate, you must first pass the legal red line!

Case: An entrepreneur in Chengdu imitated this model and contacted cleaning staff to provide free services to residents of the community in exchange for window advertising space, and then received a share of advertising from merchants. He earned hundreds of thousands in half a year. However, because he did not register the company or sign a contract, he was sued by the tenant for privacy infringement and paid tens of thousands of yuan in compensation.
items.remember:
Before imitating, you must first verify the advertising compliance with the property management and urban management. The more posters, the more fines and disputes may arise.
The deposit promise must be fulfilled truthfully, and the deposit must not be regarded as costless funds that can be spent casually, otherwise it will become illegal to start a business.
Understand the underlying logic and don’t blindly follow trends: The core of this model is traffic and channel business, not cleaning itself.

items.title: Earn 4.8 million in 15 days with zero promotion fee? Revealing the psychological strategy of community group buying and splitting and selling of expired milk for huge profits
items.core: Without spending a penny on advertising, 110 mothers’ group leaders posted a free answer in the group and sold 320,000 boxes of expired milk in 15 days to earn 4.8 million yuan! The core trick is "break the whole box and sell it in pieces": milk in the supermarket is 6.5 yuan/box, in the group it is 3.2 yuan/box - the cost of getting the goods is 9 yuan/box at a 10% discount, and the net profit is 25.2 yuan per box, with a profit margin of nearly 300%!
body: Explanation: "We didn't spend a penny on advertising. We just relied on 110 baby mama group leaders to post a free answer in the group, and sold 320,000 boxes of expired milk in 15 days, directly collecting 4.8 million yuan?!" When hearing this number, many people's first reaction was incredible: It's just a box of milk that is about to expire, how can it be possible to earn so much? The core is actually just one trick: the price deception method of "breaking the whole box and selling it in pieces"! A box of branded milk originally priced at 65 yuan has a shelf life of one and a half months. The wholesaler does not sell it as a whole box, but splits it into individual boxes and quotes. Today, let’s thoroughly uncover this set of community group buying profit-making accounts and psychological routines that manipulate human nature and make people go crazy hoarding goods! If the original price of brand milk is 65 yuan per box (12 boxes), if it is directly priced at "38.4 yuan per box for clearance," many savvy consumers will think: "It is almost expired and it costs 40 yuan less, which is not cost-effective." But the trader changed the algorithm - the whole box is broken down and counted according to the box! The leader of the group posted a chat in the group: "Big brand imported milk is on sale soon! The supermarket sells it for 6.5 yuan a box, and the group chat only costs 3.2 yuan/box!" The price of a single box has been reduced from "6.5 yuan" to "3.2 yuan". It instantly broke through the psychological defense line of consumers; when everyone placed orders by the box (12 boxes × 3.2 yuan = 38.4 yuan/box), it was 26.6 yuan cheaper than the original price. Everyone felt that they had picked up a huge bargain! Heavily paid to tie the group leaders: The wholesaler recruited 110 group leaders who were mothers of community groups, and directly gave them a high commission of 11%. The group leaders naturally shouted hard. Endorsements from acquaintances and repeat purchases: The products selected are all familiar and common brands on the market, and the taste is not bad. When the neighbor bought it and drank it at home, he thought it was okay. Not only did he repurchase it, but he also took the initiative to invite his seven aunts and eight aunts to join the group and buy it together. Countdown to order: The leader posts in the group every day to create anxiety: "The last two hundred boxes in the warehouse!" "In the last two days, it will be sold out and permanently removed from the shelves!" Under the hypnosis of herd mentality and scarcity panic, the neighbors moved box after box to their homes! Do you think paying 38.4 yuan for a box of milk originally priced at 65 yuan is "snatching the merchant's wool"? Let’s calculate the real lowest price in the industry: the purchase price of expired milk, which is only one and a half months away from the shelf life, in the bulk wholesale market is usually only 10% to 20% off the original price. Calculated, the cost of purchasing a box is only 9 yuan! Calculated at 38.4 yuan per box, the gross profit per box is as high as 29.4 yuan! After deducting the 4.2 yuan commission distributed to Bao Ma’s group leader, the trader himself makes a net profit of 25.2 yuan for each box sold (the profit margin is close to 300%)! 110 team leaders worked together at the same time. During the peak period, they could ship 20,000 to 30,000 boxes in a day, with a daily net profit of more than 500,000. After 15 days, they steadily made a net profit of 4.8 million! Strictly speaking, as long as the expired food from regular channels is within the shelf life and properly stored, normal sales are not considered illegal black and gray products. But there are double traps hidden in this method: the consumer's "pseudo-saving" trap - the shelf life is only 45 days. In the "last two days", you stock up three to five boxes at once, and the whole family drinks milk suddenly and can't finish it. In the end, it is thrown away directly after the expiration date, or you bite the bullet and drink spoiled milk and cause gastroenteritis - the twenty yuan saved turns into wasted principal and medical expenses! Entrepreneurs' trap of "supplier cutting leeks" - the core threshold of this model is "10% off source control ability" and "mature private domain leader network". If an outsider enters the game rashly, they will most likely be deceived by second-rate dealers and pay a high price to buy a batch of dead goods that cannot be sold at all. In the end, they will all rot in their own warehouses! Calculate the "time account" before placing an order: Before buying expired food, check the remaining shelf life and household consumption rate. The "half price" of endless drinks is not saving money, but a pure waste! Immune to the "countdown" rhetoric: 99% of the "last day, loss-making liquidation" in community group buying is a hunger marketing script. Don't be coerced by the solitaire atmosphere in the group and impulsively stock up...
Chapter: 📌 [Routine exposed] Two-step dismantling of harvesting 320,000 boxes

Routine: 1️⃣ The first step: dismantle parts to create the "half-price illusion", accurately grasp the psychology of price comparison 🥛 2️⃣ The second step: Bao Ma's leader fission + hunger marketing, detonating mindless hoarding 🛒
Warning: 💡 Huge profit ledger: You thought you missed something, but the merchant actually made a lot of money!
Defense method: 🛑 A refreshing summary: three iron laws of consumption

She sold 2,000 boxes in 15 days and earned more than 50,000 yuan. However, some residents complained of diarrhea after drinking the milk, and the Market Supervision Bureau intervened to impose fines and required all food on expiration dates to be removed from the shelves.

items.title: Earn 150 yuan from a mobile phone and pay 200,000 yuan in advance, but pay back? Revealing the secret behind the explosion of tens of billions of subsidies to sell goods
items.core: "If Apple gets 8999 plus state subsidy and 10 billion subsidy for 8099, he can make a net profit of one or two hundred by selling the stall." This "goods shopping" assembly line is run by the white account of college students and the extreme cash-out advance of credit cards - someone paid 200,000 yuan to stock up on 50 units of goods. The market price dropped by 213 yuan/unit in half a month, and the clearance price was more than 400 yuan!
body: Explanation: "The original price of an Apple mobile phone is 8,999 yuan. With the tens of billions of subsidies from the national subsidy superimposed platform, it only costs 8,099 yuan! If you sell it to a stall, you can make a net profit of one or two hundred yuan?" Does it sound like a "brick-and-mortar money" that is sure to make money without losing money? In the gray production circle, this business has a specialized jargon called "lucking goods." In those studios, dozens of mobile phones are lined up in a row, looking for links, dispatching orders, advancing funds, and hundreds of products running like an assembly line. But the result? Someone used up his 200,000 credit card limit and bought 50 units of goods. Not only did he not make a penny during the clearance, but he actually lost money! Today, I will take you to completely tear apart the cruel truth behind this "subsidized sex" chain! For high unit price hard currencies such as mobile phones and game consoles, the platform has strict purchase limit and risk control, and an account can only purchase them once within a period of time. If you want to move bricks in large quantities, you must constantly look for "white accounts" (clean accounts): the Luhuo Studio has extended its tentacles to the part-time job groups of college students in major universities. As soon as the subsidy link is released, the group synchronizes immediately. Students use their own real-name accounts to help place orders, and only get a meager commission of 5 to 10 yuan per order; powerful squad leaders and club presidents organize more than ten or twenty students to place orders in batches at a time, and the studio increases their commissions, and they take a cut in the middle. How can a poor student afford the principal of a mobile phone costing more than RMB 8,000? It all depends on the studio to pay or advance funds! Many traders hold three or four credit cards in their hands and take turns cashing them out. There are more than 200,000 in funds on goods in transit. Before even starting to calculate profits, the monthly credit card processing fees and capital costs alone are as high as more than 1,800 yuan! After the goods are signed and collected, the studio adds 200 to 250 yuan per unit to the package and sells them to offline digital stalls in Huaqiangbei or various places. The reason why the stall is willing to accept the price is that the price is still more than a hundred cheaper than the normal wholesale market price, and the stall can still make a profit by reselling it to individual customers. As soon as you enter and exit, the studio deducts the commission for the students, and each unit seems to pocket more than a hundred yuan. The market plunged and the position was immediately liquidated: one entrant used a credit card limit of more than 200,000 yuan and stocked up on 50 subsidized game consoles. I originally planned to earn 40 to 50 yuan from one unit, and 2,500 yuan from 50 units. As a result, in just half a month, the upstream stock release caused the recycling price at the stall to plummet, with one unit plummeting to 213 yuan! The last 50 products were forced to be cut off and sold to the stall at a low price. Not only was the work in vain, but more than 400 yuan was charged at checkout! No one can tell the truth about the damage caused by the logistics battle: 2 of the 50 units had their screens shattered during express transportation. Because they were greedy for money and did not buy enough at the guaranteed price, they had to bear the loss of several thousand yuan by themselves - and the bank will not wait for you for an extra day on the credit card repayment date! The secret idling of a big banker: A van in the logistics park unloaded 300 game consoles, without even tearing off the seals, and directly transferred them to another vehicle next to it - the delivery note was from one company, and the receipt note was from another company, and the two addresses were even in the same logistics park! This kind of large-scale, left-hand and right-hand order is used to obtain subsidies and make false invoices. The person in charge doesn't even dare to keep the quotation! On the whole chain: the platform is guaranteed to make a profit (beautiful GMV + subsidy reputation), the stalls are guaranteed to make a profit (the goods are always received at a price lower than the real-time market price), and those who only move goods in the middle are the worst - essentially, you use your own personal credit and real money cash flow to gamble on the meager interest rate in the platform subsidy that will disappear at any time! Stay away from part-time jobs like "advancing money for auctions": College students and mothers should never lend out their real-name e-commerce accounts or help with auctions for commissions of 5 yuan or 10 yuan. Once you encounter a scammer who induces transfers on the grounds of "card order, refund and re-shooting," you will instantly fall into a bottomless pit of telecommunications fraud! Don’t use your credit card to stock up on goods: using credit card cash-out funds with an annualized rate of more than ten points to profit from the meager profits of 23% on digital products is essentially walking a tightrope. As long as you encounter a market situation once...

Routine: 1️⃣ The first step: Capture the part-time job group of college students and find "clean accounts" in batches 📱 2️⃣ The second step: Cash out the credit card to the limit, and advance the studio with heavy funds 💳 3️⃣ The third step: Increase the price and give it to the stall to earn a meager "sandwich spread" 📦

He even deliberately asks you to take over the goods from him at a high price! Money is what you earn steadily, and what you earn by swiping your credit card and gambling is just money!

However, half a month later, the price of mobile phones plummeted by 213 yuan per unit. After clearing the stock, not only did he not make any profit, but he paid back more than 400 yuan. Stay away from "advancing funds for auctions" part-time job: Never lend your real-name e-commerce account to help with proxy auctions for a commission of 5 to 10 yuan. Don’t use your credit card to stock up on goods: using the cash-out capital of more than ten points per year to make a meager profit of 23% is like walking a tightrope. Once the market drops or the order is cut and the account is locked, the capital chain will be broken and the credit report will be overdue.
See through the "apprentice group" and cut leeks: Show off Apple express boxes all over the house, and recruit you to the "Internal Reporting Group and Goods Internal Group" for a fee. 99% of them are not making money by doing bricks and mortar, but they are trying to earn tuition fees, or they are looking for you to take orders at a high price and sell off the goods.
